name: Ash Of War: Prelate's Charge
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

"Prelate's Charge: Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in. Hold to continue the charge."

Usable on large and colossal axes and hammers.
effects:
Grants the Flame Art affinity (primarily Faith scaling with split physical/fire damage) and the Prelate's Charge skill.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Greataxes, Great Hammers, and Colossal Weapons (excluding Colossal Swords).
• FP Cost: 7 FP on initial slam, followed by 7 FP continuously per second/interval while holding the skill input.
• Skill Execution: Slams the weapon head into the ground creating a surge of fire, charges forward while plowing through enemies with continuous rapid multi-hits, and finishes with an upward scoop that launches lighter foes into the air upon releasing the skill button.
• Damage Scaling & Stance Damage: The slam and upward sweep deal standard weapon AR damage and significant stance damage; the intermediate charge ticks deal rapid light physical and fire damage while continuously whittling enemy poise.
• Status Buildup & Unique Mechanics: Innate weapon status effects and standard weapon greases only proc on the initial slam and final uppercut. However, weapon-buff incantations like Bloodflame Blade and Black Flame Blade apply their buildup and percentage burn on every intermediate hit. Innate weapon heal-on-hit effects (such as Great Stars) trigger on every tick of the charge.
• Equipment & Talisman Synergies: Skill damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%). Consecutive hits rapidly trigger and refresh attack buffs from Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, and Millicent's Prosthesis, as well as repetitive healing from Godskin Swaddling Cloth. Fire damage is boosted by Fire Scorpion Charm and Flame, Grant Me Strength. Godfrey Icon has no effect because the skill is channeled rather than charged.

name: Ash Of War: Barrage
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

"Barrage: Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see."

Usable on light bows.
effects:
Grants the Barrage skill and Standard affinity to compatible armaments.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable exclusively on Light Bows (such as the Shortbow, Composite Bow, Red Branch Shortbow, Misbegotten Shortbow, and Harp Bow).
• Skill Execution & FP Cost: Consumes 0 FP to enter the stance and 2 FP per arrow fired. The wielder turns the bow horizontally into a rapid-draw stance; holding either attack input looses arrows in continuous rapid succession at roughly 2.5 times the speed of normal firing. Can be aimed manually or locked on. If FP is depleted, arrows can still be fired but suffer a heavy damage penalty (~75% reduced damage).
• Damage Scaling: Scales with the equipped bow's attribute scaling and the ammunition used. Each arrow fired via the skill deals approximately 67% of the damage of a standard light bow shot.
• Status Buildup: Each arrow applies slightly reduced status buildup (~80% of normal value per hit), but the immense rate of fire makes it exceptionally potent for rapidly triggering Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison, Scarlet Rot, and Sleep.
• Stance Damage & Poise: Inflicts low stance damage per individual projectile, making it ineffective for breaking boss stance. Provides no hyper armor during readiness or firing.
• Key Synergies: Arrow damage during the skill is boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Further enhanced by Arrow's Sting Talisman, Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman, Arrow's Reach Talisman, and Blue Dancer Charm. Does not benefit from Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Barbaric Roar
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Barbaric Roar: Let out a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks."

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).
effects:
FP Cost: 16 (consumes 0 FP if depleted, reducing duration to 6 seconds and omitting the attack power bonus).
Duration: 40 seconds.

Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments excluding Daggers, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, and Whips.

Default Affinity: Heavy, enhancing Strength scaling while decreasing base damage and Dexterity scaling.

Skill Mechanics & Weapon Buff:
- Activation emits a close-range concussive roar shockwave that staggers nearby light foes without inflicting direct damage.
- Grants a temporary weapon buff conferring +7.5% physical attack power (AR) and a +5 effective bonus to weapon Strength scaling.
- Overwrites and cannot coexist with weapon greases or spell-based armament buffs (such as Electrify Armament or Bloodflame Blade).

Altered Strong Attack Combos:
- Replaces neutral and charged one-handed and two-handed strong attacks (R2/RT) with an aggressive multi-hit combo chain tailored to the armament category.
- Initial R2 input unleashes a rapid lunging multi-hit flurry (typically two forward sweeps followed by a heavy slam); a second R2 input triggers an immediate follow-up combo string.
- Charging the heavy attack increases both the damage multiplier and cumulative stance damage across each swing.
- Grants elevated hyper armor throughout the wind-up and execution of the modified strong attacks, facilitating favorable damage trades.
- Exceptional status application: every hit in the flurry applies status buildup, enabling rapid hemorrhage, frostbite, or poison triggers when applied to status-infused armaments.

Equipment & Talisman Synergies:
- Roar Medallion: Boosts the damage of the altered heavy attack combos by +15%.
- Highland Axe: Passively boosts roar-enhanced attacks by +10% when wielded in the off-hand or held while two-handing another weapon (stacks multiplicatively with Roar Medallion).
- Axe Talisman & Spiked Cracked Tear: Fully charged R2 combo chains receive the +10% (Axe Talisman) and +15% (Spiked Cracked Tear) charged attack damage bonuses.
- Consecutive Attack Buffs: Multi-hit combo chains rapidly activate and refresh attack power tiers from Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and Thorny Cracked Tear.
- Note: Shard of Alexander and Godfrey Icon do NOT boost the modified heavy attack combos, as they are treated as weapon normal/heavy attacks rather than skill-based damage.

name: Ash Of War: Blood Blade
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

"Blood Blade: Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession."

Usable on small and medium swords.
effects:
Grants the Blood affinity by default, boosting Arcane scaling and innate Hemorrhage buildup while slightly reducing base physical damage.

Skill Execution & FP/HP Cost:
• Resource Cost: Consumes 3 FP and 45 HP on initial activation; subsequent chained projectile slashes cost 3 FP each without repeating the HP tax as long as the combo sequence continues uninterrupted.
• Sequence: The wielder draws the weapon blade across their palm to self-inflict bloodletting, then performs a rapid horizontal sweep discharging an airborne crescent of blood across mid-range. Additional button inputs chain into rapid successive slashes.

Damage & Scaling Mechanics:
• Damage Type: Pure Physical damage.
• Projectile Scaling: Projectile damage scales exclusively with the armament's upgrade level and the Arcane attribute, regardless of base physical weapon Attack Rating or Strength/Dexterity scaling.
• Point-Blank Hitbox: In close melee range, both the physical weapon swing and the blood projectile connect simultaneously, dealing compounded burst damage and doubled status accumulation.
• Stance Damage: Inflicts 9 stance damage per projectile hit.

Status Buildup:
• Applies a baseline of 60 Blood Loss (Hemorrhage) buildup per projectile hit, which scales upward with Arcane investment (further enhanced under Blood and Occult affinities).

Armament Compatibility:
• Usable on small and medium swords: Daggers, Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, Backhand Blades, and Light Greatswords.
• Incompatible with Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, axes, hammers, flails, polearms, whips, fists, claws, and ranged armaments.

Equipment Synergies:
• Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
• Triggers and benefits from Lord of Blood's Exultation (+20% attack power for 20s) and White Mask (+10% attack power for 20s).
• Cannot be charged; unaffected by Godfrey Icon.
• Carian Filigreed Crest lowers FP consumption to 2 FP.

name: Ash Of War: Assassin's Gambit
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

"Assassin's Gambit: Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound. Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps."

Usable on small and medium straight swords and thrusting swords.
effects:
Grants the Occult affinity and the skill Assassin's Gambit.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 5 FP
• HP Cost: 35 HP (self-inflicted damage)
• Duration: 30 seconds
• Stealth & Invisibility: Cloaks the user in a translucent shroud, substantially decreasing the visual detection radius of non-boss PvE enemies. In PvP, it significantly reduces player lock-on range.
• Muffled Movement: Completely silences all footstep and movement audio, permitting full-speed sprinting without alerting enemies.
• Silent Cast: The skill animation generates zero noise, allowing safe activation directly behind unsuspecting targets.
• Buff Persistence: Unlike weapon coatings, the effect binds to the player character rather than the armament; switching or sheathing weapons does not cancel the buff.

Combat & Scaling Attributes:
• Damage & Stance Damage: Deals 0 damage and 0 stance damage upon activation.
• Affinity Scaling: Default Occult affinity adds physical damage scaling with Arcane, while also causing any innate status buildup (such as Blood Loss or Poison) to scale with the Arcane attribute.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on daggers, straight swords, thrusting swords, katanas, twinblades, and light greatswords (colossal weapons and large armaments excluded).

Synergies & Interactions:
• Shard of Alexander / Godfrey Icon: Ineffective, as this skill deals no direct offensive damage and cannot be charged.
• Old Lord's Talisman: Does not extend the duration, as it only affects spells rather than weapon skills.
• Carian Filigreed Crest: Reduces skill FP cost from 5 down to 4.
• Low-HP Triggers: The 35 HP self-damage can be repeatedly triggered to safely lower health into thresholds required by Red-Feathered Branchsword or Twinbird Kite Shield (<20% HP) without requiring enemy damage.

name: Ash Of War: Black Flame Tornado
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

"Black Flame Tornado: Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament."

Usable on polearms and twinblades.
effects:
Grants the Flame Art affinity (adding Faith scaling and Fire damage while reducing base physical damage and standard attribute scaling). Usable on polearms and twinblades (specifically Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Reapers, and Twinblades).

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 30 FP.
• Attack Sequence: Spins the armament continuously overhead to summon a vortex of black flame hitboxes, finishing by plunging the weapon into the ground to release a final upward erupting pillar of fire. Holding the skill input channels the spinning phase for an extended duration, spawning additional spinning flame hits prior to the slam. The spinning phase can be roll-cancelled before committing to the recovery of the ground plunge.
• Buff Interaction: Activating this skill immediately cancels active weapon coatings, spell buffs, and greases.
• Damage Scaling: Vortex hits inflict 100% Fire damage and function mechanically as bullet/spell projectiles. Damage scales exclusively with weapon upgrade level and character Faith, independent of the weapon's innate attribute scaling letters.
• Stance Damage: Deals approximately 33 total stance damage across a full, uninterrupted activation in PvE.
• Status Buildup & Percentage Burn: Does not apply weapon-innate status build-up (such as Bleed, Poison, or Frost). Instead, each vortex hit applies the Black Flame status debuff, draining approximately 1.9% of the target's maximum HP over 2 seconds. The percentage drain is static across all character levels and attributes, making it exceptionally potent against high-health bosses.
• Talisman Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage), Fire Scorpion Charm (+12% Fire damage in PvE), Flame, Grant Me Strength, and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear. Note that Godfrey Icon provides no benefit despite the skill being chargeable/channeled, and consecutive attack boosters (Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, Thorny Cracked Tear) do not trigger from its projectile vortex hits.

name: Ash Of War: Barricade Shield
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Standard affinity and the following skill:

Barricade Shield: Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt. Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows.

Usable on all shields.
effects:
Grants the Barricade Shield skill and Standard affinity to all shield types (Small Shields, Medium Shields, Greatshields, and Thrusting Shields).

• FP Cost: 12 FP per activation (reduced to 9 FP with Carian Filigreed Crest).
• Duration: 10 seconds.
• Defensive Hardness: Temporarily elevates the shield's hardness to Tier 4 (maximum tier). Causes enemy melee strikes—including heavy and two-handed attacks—to bounce off upon impact, interrupting combo strings and creating immediate counter windows.
• Guard Mitigation: Directly reduces stamina consumed when guarding against attacks: decreases stamina loss by 50% on Small and Medium Shields, and by 30% on Greatshields. Stacks multiplicatively with the shield's base Guard Boost and the Greatshield Talisman.
• Startup Frames: Activation contains active blocking frames from startup, allowing incoming strikes to be blocked immediately during the bracing animation.
• Offensive Stats: Deals no direct damage or stance damage, applies no status buildup, and does not scale with attributes or upgrade levels.
• Key Synergies: Pairs exceptionally well with the Curved Sword Talisman to capitalize on deflection stagger with reinforced Guard Counters, the Greatshield Talisman for maximum guard stamina efficiency, and Carian Filigreed Crest for sustained FP economy. It does not benefit from Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Beast's Roar
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Beast's Roar: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-traveling projectile.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Keen affinity by default and imparts the Beast's Roar skill.

• FP Cost: 10 FP
• Armament Class Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments.
• Attack Sequence: The user braces briefly and unleashes a ferocious vocal shockwave that travels forward at high speed as a linear ranged projectile.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals pure Physical (Standard) damage. Damage scales exclusively with the weapon's upgrade level and the player's Dexterity attribute, regardless of the base weapon's raw attack power.
• Stance Damage: Inflicts 6 stance damage on hit at range. Point-blank activation hits with both the startup shockwave and the projectile, inflicting a combined total of 12 stance damage.
• Status Buildup: The projectile does not inherit weapon greases, spell weapon buffs, or weapon passive status ailments (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, or Poison).
• Hyper Armor: Grants no hyper armor during casting, leaving the user vulnerable to being staggered.
• Key Synergies: Multiplicatively boosted by Roar Medallion (+15%), Highland Axe (+10% passive roar bonus when held in either hand), and Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage). The projectile's travel distance is extended by Arrow's Reach Talisman. Ineligible for Godfrey Icon enhancement as the skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Bloodhound's Step
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Bloodhound's Step: Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Consumes 5 FP and 12 Stamina to execute a high-speed evasive dash, temporarily turning the user invisible and granting extensive invulnerability frames (16 i-frames on initial activation at 30 FPS / ~32 frames at 60 FPS). Rapid consecutive activations trigger diminishing returns, reducing travel distance and i-frames (down to 14 frames at 30 FPS). Can be performed with 0 FP for 18 Stamina, but invulnerability is severely reduced (5 frames at 30 FPS). Travel distance scales favorably with Light Equip Load and enables full mobility even when Overloaded or navigating movement-impeding terrain like lava and deep swamps (though status buildup accumulation still applies). Seamlessly transitions into rolling, backstep, and crouching attacks for fast counter-offensives. Compatible with all melee armament classes. Synergizes with the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree talisman to boost evasion follow-up attacks, the Blue Dancer Charm on light-load setups, and Carian Filigreed Crest to reduce FP consumption to 4.

name: Ash Of War: Braggart's Roar
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Braggart's Roar: Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity by default. Upon activation (16 FP cost), emits a short-range shockwave dealing 6 stance damage and confers a 60-second combat buff granting +10% physical attack power, +10% all-type damage negation, and +10/s stamina recovery speed (~20% increase).

While the buff is active, two-handed heavy and charged heavy attacks transform into weapon-class-specific lunging smashes and aggressive combo chains endowed with elevated hyper armor and amplified status effect buildup multipliers (1.5x to 3.0x). The altered charged heavy attacks inflict substantial stance damage and scale with the Roar Medallion (+15%), Axe Talisman (+10%), Spiked Cracked Tear (+15%), and Highland Axe passive (+10%). Shard of Alexander and Godfrey Icon do not enhance Braggart's Roar, as it is a non-damaging, non-chargeable self-buff skill and the modified attacks register as weapon heavy attacks.

Usable on standard melee armaments except daggers, thrusting swords, heavy thrusting swords, and whips.

name: Ash Of War: Bloody Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

"Bloody Slash: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc."

Usable on swords (excluding colossal swords).
effects:
FP Cost: 6. Consumes 50 HP + 5% max HP per activation.

Armament Compatibility: Usable on small, medium, and large swords, including Daggers, Throwing Blades, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Light Greatswords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Great Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, and Heavy Thrusting Swords (excludes Colossal Swords and Colossal Weapons).

Combat Mechanics:
- Execution: The wielder lowers their stance, drawing their off-hand across the blade to sacrifice vitality, and unleashes a broad horizontal arc of pressurized blood that penetrates through multiple foes in a wide forward cone.
- Damage & Scaling: Deals Standard physical damage. The projectile damage scales with weapon upgrade level and Arcane scaling (most optimal under Blood or Occult affinities). It does not scale directly with weapon physical Attack Rating or Strength/Dexterity.
- Status Buildup: Inflicts 60 base Hemorrhage (blood loss) buildup on contact, which scales with the armament's Arcane scaling.
- Stance Damage: Inflicts poise damage determined by weapon class: 4 (Throwing Blades), 6 (Daggers), 8 (Thrusting Swords), 10 (Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Katanas, Twinblades), and 11 (Greatswords, Curved Greatswords, Light Greatswords, Great Katanas, Heavy Thrusting Swords).
- Poise & Hyper Armor: Hyper armor during the startup and swing is dynamic, determined by armor poise and the weapon class's intrinsic poise, offering greater uninterruptibility on heavier sword classes.
- Key Synergies: Skill damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Proccing blood loss on enemies activates Lord of Blood's Exultation (+20% attack power for 20s) and White Mask (+10% attack power for 20s). Self-inflicted health depletion facilitates fast activation of the Red-Feathered Branchsword threshold (<20% HP). Cannot be charged, and therefore receives no benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Carian Greatsword
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Carian Greatsword: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power."

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Carian Greatsword skill.

• FP Cost: 16 (uncharged or charged).
• Attack Sequence: Envelops the armament in glintstone sorcery to materialize a giant magic blade, executing a crushing overhead vertical slam. Holding the skill input charges the attack, expanding the blade's size and reach while substantially elevating its damage and stagger force.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on small and medium sword types, including Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, and Heavy Thrusting Swords. Ineligible for Colossal Swords and Colossal Weapons.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals 100% pure Magic damage. Damage is dictated by weapon upgrade level and weapon Intelligence scaling (greatest under Magic or Cold affinity, or native Intelligence scaling). Physical stats (Strength/Dexterity) and base physical attack power do not affect the magical blade's damage.
• Stance Damage: Deals 20 stance damage uncharged, increasing to 25 stance damage when fully charged. Capable of flattening human-sized enemies and swiftly breaking bosses' stance.
• Key Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard (+15% / +10% skill damage), Godfrey Icon (+15% damage when fully charged), Spellblade Set (+2% magic skill damage per armor piece, +8% total), Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20% magic damage), and Carian Filigreed Crest (reduces FP cost from 16 to 12).

name: Ash Of War: Carian Grandeur
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Carian Grandeur: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels."

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).
effects: Costs 26 FP across all charge stages (consuming 30 stamina uncharged, 40 stamina at stage 1, and 60 stamina at full charge). Conjures an enormous glintstone greatsword and executes a devastating vertical overhead strike. The skill features three charge tiers (uncharged, stage 1 charge, and stage 2 maximum charge); each charge level dramatically increases the length, width, reach, and power of the spectral blade. Compatible with daggers, straight swords, greatswords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, twinblades, thrusting swords, and heavy thrusting swords (colossal weapons and colossal swords are excluded). The conjured blade functions as a magical projectile hitbox dealing pure Magic damage, scaling strictly with the weapon's upgrade level and the wielder's Intelligence stat (maximizing output on Magic and Cold affinities); physical weapon AR, Strength, and Dexterity do not contribute to the magic strike, and auxiliary weapon status buildup is not applied. Deals heavy stance damage (approximately 20 uncharged, 30 at stage 1, and 45 at stage 2), knocking down or flattening standard humanoid targets. Hyper armor during the windup and charge animation scales with the armament class: heavier weapons (greatswords, curved greatswords, heavy thrusting swords) grant substantial hyper armor frames, whereas light weapons (daggers, straight swords, katanas) grant none. Synergizes with the Godfrey Icon (+15% damage when fully charged), Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage), Magic Scorpion Charm (+12% magic damage), Spellblade Set (+2% magic skill damage per piece, up to +8%), and the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20% magic damage).

name: Ash Of War: Carian Retaliation
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Carian Retaliation: Swing the shield to dispel incoming sorceries and incantations, transforming the magic into retaliatory glintblades. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."

Usable on small and medium shields.
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Carian Retaliation skill. Compatible with small and medium shields.

Mechanics & Attack Sequence:
• Parry Deflection: Swings the shield to deflect physical melee strikes. At 60 FPS, features 8 startup frames, 12 active parry frames, and 26-28 recovery frames, matching the active window of the Buckler Parry while granting medium shields top-tier parry efficacy alongside 100% physical damage negation.
• Spell Retaliation: Swings create an azure ward that dispels incoming sorceries, incantations, and magical projectiles upon contact. Successfully dispelling a spell summons three spectral glintblades over the user's head that automatically home in on hostile targets.
• FP Cost: 0 FP on neutral swings or physical parries; 8 FP consumed only upon successfully absorbing a projectile to generate glintblades.
• Damage & Scaling: Glintblade magic damage scales strictly with shield upgrade level (+0 through +25 / +10) and the shield's affinity scaling (optimally Magic or Cold).
• Stance Damage: Physical parries inflict standard posture breaks against parriable foes and bosses. Retaliatory glintblades deal low individual stance damage (~1.5 to 2 per blade, ~4.5 to 6 total).
• Status Buildup: None.
• Key Synergies: Glintblade projectile damage is amplified by Shard of Alexander (+15%), Magic Scorpion Charm (+12%), Ritual Sword Talisman (+10%), and the Spellblade Set (+2% per armor piece, up to +8%). FP consumption on spell absorption is reduced to 6 FP by Carian Filigreed Crest. Unaffected by Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Blood Tax
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

"Blood Tax: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP."

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (excluding colossal weapons).
effects:
Grants the Blood affinity by default, adding Arcane scaling and innate Hemorrhage (blood loss) build-up while reducing base damage and other attribute scalings. Grants the skill 'Blood Tax' (FP Cost: 14).

Combat Mechanics:
- Attack Sequence: The wielder winds their armament backward in a twisting motion before releasing a rapid 4-hit flurry of thrusts.
- Damage & Motion Values: Motion values are approximately 88 for the 1st hit, 44 for the 2nd and 3rd hits, and 110 for the 4th hit, scaling directly with the armament's level and overall Attack Rating (AR).
- HP Siphon: Landing hits restores health to the user based on maximum HP plus a flat amount. Hits 1–3 each restore 2% max HP + 25 HP, while the final hit restores 4% max HP + 45 HP, totaling 10% max HP + 120 HP if all four strikes connect.
- Status Buildup: Applies 100% status build-up on the 1st hit, 50% on the 2nd and 3rd hits, and 100% on the 4th hit (300% total base status across the full sequence). Highly effective when paired with weapons that have innate bleed or when infused with Blood/Occult affinities scaling with Arcane.
- Stance Damage: Inflicts a combined total of 16 stance damage (4 on hit 1, 2 on hits 2 and 3, and 8 on hit 4).
- Hyper Armor: Provides low poise/hyper armor during activation, requiring careful timing to avoid disruption.
- Compatibility: Usable on all thrusting-capable armaments (excluding colossal weapons), including Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Light Greatswords, Katanas, Great Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Throwing Blades, and Thrusting Shields.
- Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% damage) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10% damage). Rapid successive hits quickly trigger multi-tier attack buffs from Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Winged Sword Insignia, and Millicent's Prosthesis. Hemorrhage procs trigger Lord of Blood's Exultation (+20% attack power) and White Mask (+10% attack power). Healing stacks with Godskin Swaddling Cloth for enhanced survivability. Cannot be charged, and thus does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Charge Forth
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Charge Forth: Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance."

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.
effects:
Grants the Quality affinity by default, balancing Strength and Dexterity scaling, but can be altered with appropriate Whetblades.

Skill Mechanics:
- FP Cost: 16 FP
- Armament Compatibility: Usable on polearms capable of thrusting (Spears, Great Spears, and thrust-capable Halberds), Heavy Thrusting Swords, and Twinblades.
- Attack Execution: The wielder lowers the armament to the hip and charges rapidly forward, channeling momentum into a piercing thrust. Holding the skill input extends the travel distance and duration of the sprint before unleashing the final thrust. The charge phase deals no damage along its path; all damage, status buildup, and poise impact are concentrated entirely into the concluding thrust.
- Stance & Poise Damage: Inflicts 24 stance damage upon landing the final thrust, making it effective for breaking enemy stances and staggering foes.
- Hyper Armor: Grants active hyper armor throughout the charge and recovery frames, mitigating incoming poise damage and preventing interruption from light-to-medium enemy attacks.
- Damage Type & Scaling: Deals pure Pierce damage scaling with armament upgrade level, base attack rating, and affinity attributes. Only the finishing thrust can be parried.
- Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage). Receives charge bonus from Godfrey Icon when held. Capitalizes heavily on thrust counterattack mechanics, synergizing with the Spear Talisman (+15% counterattack damage) when hitting enemies during attack animations. Applies full weapon status buildup (such as Blood Loss, Frostbite, Poison, or Rot) on hit.

name: Ash Of War: Chilling Mist
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

"Chilling Mist: Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while."

Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
effects:
Grants the Cold affinity, adding Intelligence scaling, lowering default base physical scaling, and granting innate Frostbite accumulation.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 14 FP (Stamina: 16). Performing the skill with insufficient FP executes a weak physical sweep without frost infusion or mist generation.
• Action Sequence: The user sweeps the armament through the air, simultaneously coating the blade in frost and releasing an expansive, lingering mist cloud that persists for 5 seconds.
• Weapon Coating: Bestows a temporary frost enchantment upon the weapon lasting 40 seconds, adding a flat +60 Frostbite buildup to all direct weapon attacks (stacks cumulatively with innate or Cold affinity Frostbite buildup).
• Status Buildup & Damage: The initial sweeping slash inflicts direct physical/magic damage scaling with weapon attack rating and applies 120 Frostbite buildup on hit. The lingering mist deals no direct hit damage but rapidly inflicts 120 Frostbite buildup per tick to enemies caught inside.
• Stance Damage & Hyper Armor: The slash deals standard weapon-class-dependent stance damage (approximately 8–13 poise damage in PvE); the mist deals zero stance damage. The skill does not provide hyper armor during the startup or swing.
• Armament Compatibility: Can be applied to all melee armaments with the exception of Whips, Fists, and Claws (also incompatible with Bows, Crossbows, Shields, and Catalysts).
• Key Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% damage to the physical/magic weapon slash) and the Spellblade Set (+2% magic skill damage per piece). Ineligible for Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged. FP consumption is reduced to 11 FP when paired with Carian Filigreed Crest.

name: Ash Of War: Cragblade
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Cragblade: Skill that manipulates gravity. Bury the armament in the ground, pulling rocks from the earth to reinforce it. Increases attack power and makes it easier to break enemy stance.

Usable on melee armaments (whips excepted).
effects: Costs 16 FP to cast. The user drives the armament into the ground and wrenches it free, coating the striking end in gravitic stone crags. Both the initial ground plunge and the pull-up possess small close-range physical hitboxes that deal minor poise damage. Upon completion, enchants the weapon for 60 seconds with a +15% boost to physical attack power, a +10% boost to stance (poise) damage on all attacks, and a +50% increase to stamina damage dealt against blocking targets. Compatible with all melee armament classes except whips (including daggers, swords, greatswords, colossal weapons, axes, hammers, flails, spears, halberds, reapers, fists, and claws). Counts as a weapon buff and is incompatible with weapon coatings or greases (e.g., Scholar's Armament, Bloodflame Blade). Does not scale with or benefit from Shard of Alexander on normal weapon swings (only applies to the activation hitboxes), and cannot be charged (Godfrey Icon is ineffective). Stacks multiplicatively with the Stonebarb Cracked Tear (+30% stance damage) and synergizes exceptionally with the Axe Talisman, Curved Sword Talisman, and Dagger Talisman for stance-breaking heavy attack playstyles.

name: Ash Of War: Double Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Double Slash: Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."

Usable on swords and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
Grants the Keen affinity by default, increasing Dexterity scaling while decreasing Strength scaling and base damage. When activated, the user drops into a low stance and executes a rapid 2-hit crossing slash for 6 FP. Pressing the skill button again performs a spinning 3-hit combination for 3 FP, and a final input delivers a downward overhead slash for 3 FP (totaling 6 hits across 3 inputs for 12 FP total).

• Attack Sequence & Motion Values: Strike 1 deals 92% weapon attack power, Strike 2 deals 105%, Strike 3 deals 84%, Strike 4 deals 86%, Strike 5 deals 115%, and Strike 6 deals 145%, achieving a cumulative 627% motion value across the full chain.
• Stance Damage: Deals cumulative poise damage scaling by weapon class. Standard swords, curved swords, twinblades, and katanas deal 3.75, 5.0, 3.75, 3.75, 5.0, and 10.0 poise damage per respective strike (31.25 stance damage total). Greatswords, halberds, and reapers inflict up to 34.38 total stance damage across the combo.
• Status Buildup: Applies 525% of the weapon's innate status accumulation over the sequence (Input 1: 175%, Input 2: 250%, Input 3: 100%). Flat auxiliary buffs (such as Bloodflame Blade, Poison Armament, and greases) apply their flat status values across every connecting strike, making the combo exceptionally potent for rapid bleed, frost, or poison triggers.
• Scaling: Damage scales directly with armament attack rating and weapon upgrade level.
• Compatibility: Usable on daggers, straight swords, greatswords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, twinblades, slashing halberds, and reapers. Ineligible for colossal weapons, colossal swords, thrust-only weapons, axes, hammers, flails, spears, and fists/claws.
• Synergies: Fully boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Rapid multi-hit execution quickly ramps up consecutive attack buffs including Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and Thorny Cracked Tear. Not chargeable; Godfrey Icon provides no benefit.

name: Ash Of War: Determination
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Determination: A knightly skill. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, powering up your next attack.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Quality affinity by default, balancing Strength and Dexterity scaling, though affinity can be altered with appropriate Whetblades.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 10 FP.
• Cast Time & Hyper Armor: Fast activation animation (~1.0 second) wherein the wielder raises the armament to face level; provides minimal hyper armor during startup.
• Duration: 10 seconds, or until a single attack connects with a target, surface, or shield.
• Damage Amplification (PvE): Increases total damage (physical and elemental) of the next landed attack by +60%. Increases critical hit (riposte / backstab) damage by +20%.
• Damage Amplification (PvP): Increases next landed standard attack damage by +30% and critical hit damage by +15%.
• Stance & Status: Does not increase stance damage, poise damage, or status effect buildup (such as Bleed, Poison, or Frostbite).
• Buff Classification & Stacking: Functions as a unique skill buff on the armament. Stacks multiplicatively with Aura buffs (e.g., Golden Vow), Body buffs (e.g., Flame, Grant Me Strength), passive weapon coatings (Greases and Armament Sorceries/Incantations), and Flask of Wondrous Physick tears.

Armament Compatibility:
• Usable on all melee armaments (Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Axes, Greataxes, Hammers, Flails, Great Hammers, Colossal Weapons, Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Reapers, Whips, Fists, and Claws).
• Incompatible with ranged weapons and catalysts.

Talisman & Gear Interactions:
• Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Ineffective; does not enhance Determination because it is a utility self-buff that deals no innate attack damage.
• Godfrey Icon: Incompatible; the skill cannot be charged.
• Old Lord's Talisman: Incompatible; affects only spells, not weapon skills.
• Synergizes multiplicatively with attack-type enhancers including Axe Talisman and Spiked Cracked Tear (charged attacks), Claw Talisman and Raptor's Black Feathers (jump attacks), Dagger Talisman (critical hits), Spear Talisman (thrust counters), Ritual Sword Talisman, and Red-Feathered Branchsword.

name: Ash Of War: Earthshaker
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Earthshaker: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash an earth-shaking shockwave. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."

Usable on greataxes, great hammers, great spears, and colossal weapons.
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity (enhancing Strength scaling while reducing base damage and other scalings). Costs 10 FP for the initial ground thrust and shockwave, plus an optional 5 FP for the strong attack follow-up (15 FP total). When executed with insufficient FP, no shockwave occurs, damage is reduced by 50%, and stamina consumption increases by 50%.

Attack Sequence:
1. Ground Thrust: The armament is plunged into the earth, inflicting direct physical weapon damage and light stagger.
2. Shockwave: Gathering strength triggers an expansive 360-degree ground tremor that deals heavy physical damage, staggering or knocking down standard-sized enemies.
3. Follow-up Sweep: Pressing strong attack executes a wide horizontal cleave with high motion value, striking all foes in an arc.

Armament Compatibility:
Equippable exclusively on Greataxes, Great Hammers, Great Spears, and Colossal Weapons (including Colossal Swords).

Damage Scaling & Properties:
Inflicts pure physical damage. Direct weapon hits (thrust and sweep) scale with weapon Attack Rating and can apply active weapon buffs (greases, weapon enchantments) and innate status buildup (such as Bleed, Frostbite, or Poison). The shockwave scales with weapon upgrade level and Strength attribute scaling; status effects and elemental weapon buffs do not carry over to the shockwave.

Stance Damage & Hyper Armor:
Delivers approximately 36 total stance damage across the full combo (~6 on the plunge, ~15 on the shockwave, and ~15 on the sweeping follow-up). Provides substantial hyper armor frames throughout the gathering and shockwave animation, allowing the wielder to trade through enemy attacks.

Synergies:
- Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Boosts the damage of both the shockwave and follow-up sweep by 15% / 10%.
- Godfrey Icon: Has no effect; the skill is not chargeable.
- Roar Medallion: Has no effect; unlike Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker, standard Earthshaker does not contain a roar component.
- Axe Talisman: Has no effect; does not boost skill follow-up strong attacks.

name: Ash Of War: Enchanted Shot
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Enchanted Shot: Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target.

Usable on light bows and longbows.
effects:
Grants the weapon skill Enchanted Shot.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Light Bows and Longbows. Cannot be equipped on Greatbows, Crossbows, or Ballistas.
• Affinity: None (Bows cannot accept elemental or physical affinity infusions; base scaling and damage profiles are retained).
• Skill Behavior & Attack Sequence: The wielder draws the bow into a steady stance, imbuing the nocked arrow with pale blue spiritual essence. When fired at a locked-on target, the arrow travels at accelerated projectile velocity and actively curves in flight to home in on the foe, tracking agile and dodging enemies. If fired without lock-on, it travels in a swift, straight path.
• FP Cost: 8 FP per shot. Can be performed when FP is depleted, but the arrow loses its tracking homing capability and velocity boost, and bonus damage is reduced from +50% down to roughly +5%.
• Damage Scaling: Deals approximately 1.5x (50% increase) arrow damage compared to a standard light attack shot from the same bow. Damage scales according to the bow's attribute scaling (Strength/Dexterity), reinforcement level, and the equipped arrow's base damage attributes.
• Status Build-Up: Enhances status ailment application (Blood Loss, Poison, Scarlet Rot, Frostbite, Sleep) by approximately 50% when using status-inflicting ammunition.
• Stance Damage: Inflicts roughly 1.5x the base stance/poise damage of a regular bow shot; highly effective for scoring critical headshot staggers and knocking flying enemies from the air.
• Key Synergies:
 - Shard of Alexander: Increases skill damage by 15%.
 - Arrow's Sting Talisman: Boosts arrow damage by 10%, stacking multiplicatively with Ash of War skill damage buffs.
 - Arrow's Reach Talisman: Increases effective arrow range and drastically delays damage falloff at long distances.
 - Carian Filigreed Crest: Reduces FP cost from 8 to 6.
 - Status Ammunition: Excellent synergy with St. Trina's Arrows (Sleep) and Serpent Arrows (Poison) for high-reliability status application at range.

name: Ash Of War: Endure
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Endure: Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the user an anchored brace stance upon activation.

• FP Cost: 9 FP (can be triggered with insufficient FP at significantly reduced efficiency).
• Duration: 3 seconds.
• Defensive Buff & Poise: Upon activation with FP, increases all damage negation (Physical, Magic, Fire, Lightning, and Holy) by 45% (30% in PvP) and grants near-unbreakable hyper armor/poise, preventing flinching or staggering from almost all standard and heavy attacks. Without FP, damage negation is reduced to 10% (7% in PvP) with weak stagger resistance. Grab attacks, status buildup procs (such as Hemorrhage or Frostbite), and certain catastrophic knockbacks can still interrupt the player.
• Armament Class Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments (daggers, straight swords, greatswords, colossal swords, curved swords, katanas, twinblades, thrusting swords, axes, hammers, flails, spears, halberds, reapers, whips, fists, claws, and colossal weapons). Incompatible with shields and ranged armaments.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals no direct damage or stance damage on activation. Default affinity is Heavy, raising Strength scaling; can be altered to other affinities using whetblades.
• Key Synergies: Unaffected by offensive skill boosters like Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon due to having no damaging component. Synergizes exceptionally well with slow, heavy attacks, charged spells, and incantations by guaranteeing uninterruptible casting windows. Stacks multiplicatively with defensive talismans (such as the Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman) and damage-negation consumables or incantations.

name: Ash Of War: Eruption
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

"Eruption: Skill of the knights who serve at Volcano Manor. Slam armament into the ground, spawning roiling lava which spouts up upon release."

Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.
effects:
Grants the Fire affinity by default, providing Fire damage and Strength scaling while decreasing base physical damage and other scalings.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 14 FP per use.
• Execution: The wielder raises their weapon and drives it forcefully into the ground with high hyper armor, spawning a pool of roiling magma. Upon wrenching the armament free, a column of lava erupts upward, inflicting heavy Fire damage and launching or knocking back lighter enemies.
• Magma Pool Duration: The pool of molten rock remains on the ground for approximately 5 seconds, dealing rapid continuous ticks of Fire damage to any enemies standing within its radius.
• Stance Damage: The direct physical weapon slam deals 22 stance damage. The eruption and subsequent magma ticks contribute steady poise pressure (approx. 1 stance damage per tick).
• Scaling: The weapon slam scales directly with weapon level and total Attack Rating (AR). The eruption plume and lingering magma pools scale primarily with weapon upgrade level and Strength (or Faith when infused with Flame Art affinity).
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Large and Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Greataxes, Great Hammers, Colossal Weapons, Great Katanas, and Heavy Thrusting Swords.
• Status Buildup: Innate weapon status buildup (such as Hemorrhage or Frostbite) applies only on the initial weapon slam hit; lingering magma ticks and the eruptive plume do not transmit weapon status effects.
• Key Synergies: Amplified by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage), Talisman of the Dread (+14% magma skill attack power), Fire Scorpion Charm (+12% Fire damage), Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20% Fire damage), and the 'Flame, Grant Me Strength' incantation (+20% Physical and Fire damage). Eruption is not chargeable and receives no benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Flame Of The Redmanes
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

"Flame of the Redmanes: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Produce a powerful burst of flames in a wide frontward arc."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Fire affinity (or Flame Art affinity when using the Red-Hot Whetblade). Costs 14 FP per cast.

Mechanics & Attack Sequence:
The user swings the armament forward, unleashing a wide, conical blast of roaring fire across an approximate 120-degree frontal arc up to medium range. The flames penetrate through multiple foes simultaneously, providing reliable crowd control and area-of-effect damage.

Armament Compatibility:
Applicable to all melee armaments without fixed skills, including daggers, straight swords, greatswords, colossal swords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, twinblades, thrusting swords, heavy thrusting swords, axes, greataxes, hammers, flails, warhammers, colossal weapons, spears, great spears, halberds, reapers, whips, fists, and claws.

Damage & Scaling:
Deals pure Fire damage. Projectile damage scales primarily with armament upgrade level and Strength (shifting to Faith scaling when set to Flame Art affinity).

Stance Damage:
Inflicts 10 stance damage in PvE.

Synergies & Interactions:
- Skill damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
- Fire damage is amplified by Fire Scorpion Charm (+12%), Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%), Flame, Grant Me Strength (+20%), and Golden Vow (+15%).
- Targets doused with Oil Pots or Roped Oil Pots take +50% fire damage from the next flame strike.
- The skill cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.
- Possesses low hyper armor during startup, leaving the caster open to interruption if hit before the flames erupt.

name: Ash Of War: Flaming Strike
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

"Flaming Strike: Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike. This will also coat the armament in fire."

Usable on melee armaments (colossal weapons and whips excepted).
effects:
FP Cost: 4 FP for the initial flame wave; 10 FP for the heavy follow-up attack (14 FP total).

Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments, excluding Colossal Weapons and Whips.

Attack Sequence & Mechanics:
• Initial Skill Input: Sweeps the armament to emit a wide, horizontal sheet of flames in a 180-degree forward arc dealing pure fire damage and staggering unshielded targets.
• Follow-up Input: Executing a strong attack immediately after the flame cast performs a swift, lunging horizontal slash that deals combined physical and fire damage.
• Weapon Buff: Performing the follow-up strike enchants the weapon with fire, granting a flat +90 Fire Attack Power buff for 40 seconds. This buff applies regardless of weapon affinity and persists through two-handing changes, but dispels if the weapon is sheathed or switched.

Damage Scaling & Stance Damage:
• The initial flame wave damage scales primarily with weapon upgrade level and the weapon's Strength scaling.
• The follow-up sweep deals damage scaled directly from the weapon's total attack power and motion values.
• Inflicts approximately 10 stance damage on the flame burst and 15 stance damage on the lunging sweep (~25 stance damage total when both connect).

Key Synergies:
• Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10% skill damage), affecting both the flame wave and the follow-up strike.
• Fire damage is enhanced by Fire Scorpion Charm (+12%), Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%), and Flame, Grant Me Strength (+20% Physical, +20% Fire damage).
• Does not possess a chargeable stance; receives no bonus from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Golden Land
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Golden Land: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash a blast of sacred energy that coalesces into golden darts. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."

Usable on greataxes, great hammers, great spears, and colossal weapons.
effects:
Grants the Sacred affinity (adds Holy damage and Faith scaling while reducing physical base damage) and enables the skill Golden Land.

• FP Cost: 16 (Initial cast) + 5 (Follow-up heavy attack)
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Greataxes, Great Hammers, Great Spears, and Colossal Weapons.
• Attack Sequence:
 - Initial Slam & Blast: The wielder plunges the armament into the earth, unleashing a holy eruption that inflicts heavy Holy and physical damage, dealing approximately 40 stance damage.
 - Golden Darts: A volley of homing sacred darts coalesces above the shockwave and tracks nearby enemies, inflicting Holy damage.
 - Heavy Follow-Up: Triggered with a strong attack input to perform a wide sweeping strike with the armament for high physical damage and stagger.
• Charge Mechanic: Can be charged to enhance the damage of the eruption and projectile barrage.
• Notable Synergies:
 - Weapon Passives: Each individual dart and strike counts as a distinct hit, allowing weapons with hit-based recovery (such as Great Stars) to restore 1% max HP per connecting projectile.
 - Talismans: Multiplicatively boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage), Godfrey Icon (+15% when charged), and Sacred Scorpion Charm (+12% Holy damage).

name: Ash Of War: Glintblade Phalanx
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Glintblade Phalanx: Skill used by the enchanted knights who served the Carian royal family. Form an arch of magic glintblades overhead, which will attack foes automatically. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust."

Usable on swords and polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Glintblade Phalanx skill.

• Skill Mechanics:
 - Initial Cast (10 FP): Conjures an arch of 4 translucent magical glintblades above the wielder that hover momentarily before automatically acquiring and firing at nearby targets.
 - Heavy Attack Follow-up (4 FP): Executing a strong attack while blades are active or immediately following their cast triggers a rapid, long-range lunging thrust with the armament.

• Weapon Compatibility:
 - Usable on swords and polearms capable of thrusting (Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Curved Swords, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Great Spears, and thrusting Halberds). Colossal weapons and non-thrusting armaments are excluded.

• Damage & Scaling:
 - Default affinity adds Magic damage and Intelligence scaling while lowering physical base damage and Strength/Dexterity scaling.
 - Glintblade projectile damage scales primarily with the weapon's upgrade level and Intelligence stat, independent of physical weapon infusion.
 - Follow-up lunging thrust deals full melee weapon damage and weapon-infusion scaling.

• Stance / Poise Damage:
 - Each projectile inflicts 5 stance damage (totaling 20 stance damage if all four connect).
 - The follow-up thrust inflicts weapon-class specific heavy thrust stance damage (typically 12–22 stance damage).

• Synergies:
 - Damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
 - Glintblade damage is boosted by each piece of the Spellblade Set (+2% per piece, up to +8%), Magic Scorpion Charm (+12%), and the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%).
 - The thrust follow-up qualifies for the Spear Talisman (+15% counterattack damage).
 - Cannot be charged; Godfrey Icon does not apply.

name: Ash Of War: Glintstone Pebble
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Glintstone Pebble: A skill that employs the glintstone sorcery of the same name. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust, performed while the armament is still imbued with glintstone."

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the skill Glintstone Pebble.

Skill Mechanics & Sequence:
• Skill Activation (8 FP): Casts a glintstone projectile dealing pure magic damage at medium range with quick startup.
• Follow-Up Heavy Attack (4 FP): Pressing the strong attack input during or immediately after the cast chains into a long-distance lunging thrust while the armament remains imbued with glintstone (12 FP total for the complete combo).
• Damage Scaling: The initial glintstone projectile scales strictly with weapon upgrade level and character Intelligence (independent of weapon physical attack rating). The follow-up thrust scales with total weapon Attack Rating (AR) and the weapon's attribute scaling, delivering weapon-based physical and magic damage with high motion values.
• Stance Damage: The glintstone projectile inflicts 3 stance damage and brief hitstun. The follow-up thrust inflicts heavy stance damage based on weapon class: 12 (Daggers), 16 (Thrusting Swords), 20 (Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Halberds), and 22 (Greatswords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Great Spears).
• Status Buildup & Counterattacks: The projectile does not apply weapon status buildup. The follow-up thrust applies weapon status buildup (such as Blood Loss, Frostbite, or Poison) at full melee motion rates. As a piercing thrust, the follow-up attack is capable of dealing pierce counter damage.

Armament Compatibility:
• Usable on swords and polearms capable of thrusting: Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Great Spears, and Halberds.
• Incompatible with Colossal Swords and Colossal Weapons.

Synergies & Equipment Boosts:
• Skill Damage: Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
• Magic Damage: Magic damage from both the projectile and the thrust is boosted by Magic Scorpion Charm (+12%) and Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%).
• Armor Synergy: Rogier's Spellblade Set enhances both attacks by 2% per piece (up to +8% total).
• Counter Hits: The follow-up thrust counterattacks are boosted by the Spear Talisman (+15%).
• Unchargeable: Cannot be charged; does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Giant Hunt
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Giant Hunt: Skill developed for confronting gigantic foes. Step forward from a low stance, carrying the momentum into a sudden upward thrust.

Usable on large and colossal weapons capable of thrusting, spears, and twinblades.
effects:
FP Cost: 16 FP.

Attack Sequence & Mechanics:
• Execution: The user ducks into a low crouch and lunges forward before driving the weapon upward in a forceful thrust.
• Low Hitbox Evasion: The ducking animation at the start of the wind-up substantially lowers the user's hurtbox, allowing incoming high horizontal strikes and projectile attacks to pass harmlessly overhead.
• Crowd Control: Humanoid and medium-sized targets struck by the upward thrust are propelled upward into the air and suffer a hard knockdown upon landing, enabling potent okizeme follow-up opportunities. Large foes suffer heavy stagger.
• Damage Type & Scaling: Deals pure Pierce damage with an attack power motion value of 220% (2.2x base weapon attack power). Hits delivered while an opponent is mid-attack trigger pierce counter-attack damage bonuses.
• Stance Damage: Deals 36 stance damage when used with Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Great Spears, and Great Katanas; deals 30 stance damage with Spears, Halberds, and Twinblades.
• Hyper Armor: Grants Tier 2 hyper armor during the forward lunge and thrust animation, conferring high poise and damage resistance to trade through incoming light and medium attacks.
• Status Buildup: Applies 100% of the armament's native or infused status buildup values (Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, Rot) upon impact.

Armament Compatibility:
• Large and colossal weapons capable of thrusting (Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Great Spears, Halberds, Great Katanas, Thrusting Shields), as well as Spears and Twinblades.

Key Synergies:
• Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Directly increases the skill's damage output by 15% (or 10%).
• Spear Talisman: Amplifies thrust counter-attack damage by an additional 15% when striking enemies during their active attack animations.
• Godfrey Icon: Ineffective; Giant Hunt cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Golden Parry
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Parry: Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance. Effective even at a slight distance.

Usable on small and medium shields.
effects:
Grants the Sacred affinity and the skill Golden Parry. Usable on small and medium shields.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 4 FP per attempt. FP is consumed upon activation regardless of whether the parry connects.
• Parry Window (60 FPS): 8 startup frames, 12 active parry frames, and 19 recovery frames. Retains identical top-tier frame data across both small shields and medium shields, eliminating the frame delay and active window penalty typical of medium shield parries.
• Extended Reach: Emits an expanding wave of golden Erdtree light that dramatically extends the parry hitbox forward, enabling deflection of parriable melee attacks and weapon skills from well outside conventional weapon contact range.
• Zero FP Penalty: If attempted with insufficient FP, the animation plays without the golden light wave, and frame data degrades severely to default parry timing (12 startup frames, 4 active frames).
• Deflection & Stance: Successfully timing the deflection interrupts parriable melee attacks and breaks standard enemies' stance for a critical strike (riposte). Certain elite adversaries and bosses require multiple consecutive parries (typically 2 to 3) before opening to a riposte.
• Attack Type Compatibility: Deflects physical melee strikes and physical weapon skills only; cannot parry sorceries, incantations, arrows, or ranged projectiles. The parry itself inflicts no direct HP damage or status buildup.
• Affinity & Scaling: Default Sacred affinity adds Faith scaling and Holy damage to shield strikes while reducing base physical damage and physical scaling.
• Equipment & Talisman Synergies: Does not deal attack damage or charge, offering no synergy with the Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon. Pairs exceptionally well with critical attack enhancers such as the Dagger Talisman, Blade of Mercy, Assassin's Crimson Dagger, and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger. Equipping on high-guard-boost medium shields with 100% physical damage negation (such as the Brass Shield) maximizes defense during mistimed partial parries.

name: Ash Of War: Golden Slam
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Slam: Skill of the avatars who protect Minor Erdtrees. Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
FP Cost: 22.
Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments (swords, daggers, polearms, axes, hammers, colossal weapons, whips, fists, and claws).
Default Affinity: Sacred (adds Holy damage and Faith scaling, while reducing physical base damage and non-Faith scaling; can be altered via whetblades).
Attack Mechanics: The wielder crouches and leaps high into the air before crashing down onto the ground in a forceful pratfall slam. The move delivers a two-stage attack consisting of a direct physical body slam followed immediately by an expansive 360-degree radial golden shockwave dealing Holy damage.
Damage Scaling: The direct physical impact scales with armament upgrade level and weapon attack rating; the golden shockwave scales with armament upgrade level and Faith.
Stance Damage: Delivers a total of 46 stance damage (30 from the physical impact, 16 from the holy shockwave), making it potent for staggering elite foes and bosses.
Hyper Armor: Possesses substantial hyper armor throughout the jump and slam phases, granting high resistance to interruption from standard enemy attacks.
Chargeability: Cannot be charged (Godfrey Icon does not apply).
Synergies: Benefits from Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard (boosts skill damage by 15% and 10% respectively), Sacred Scorpion Charm (boosts Holy shockwave damage by 12% in PvE / 8% in PvP), and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear (boosts Holy damage by 20% for 3 minutes).

name: Ashes Of War: Golden Vow
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Vow: Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the weapon the Sacred affinity by default, infusing it with Holy damage and Faith scaling while reducing base physical damage and attribute scaling. Can also be applied with Standard, Heavy, Keen, Quality, or Lightning affinities using the appropriate Whetblades.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments.
• Skill Execution & Sequence: The wielder raises their weapon high overhead in a reverent pledge, calling down golden light to bestow a radiant aura on themselves and nearby allies within a 10-meter radius.
• FP Cost: 40 FP (reduced to 30 FP with Carian Filigreed Crest).
• Buff Category: Aura Buff.
• Duration: 45 seconds.
• Offensive Bonus: Increases all damage dealt by +11.5% in PvE (+2.5% in PvP).
• Defensive Bonus: Increases all damage negation across physical and elemental types by +7.5% in PvE (+1.5% in PvP).
• Stance Damage & Status Buildup: Deals no direct damage, stance damage, or status buildup; causes no hitstun.
• Stacking Rules: Mutually exclusive with other Aura Buffs (such as the Golden Vow incantation, Rallying Standard, or Shared Order), overwriting or being overwritten. Stacks multiplicatively with Body Buffs (e.g., Flame, Grant Me Strength, Boiled Crab), Weapon Buffs (e.g., greases, weapon-coating skills), Health Regen buffs, and passive talisman bonuses.
• Talisman Interactions: Does not benefit from Shard of Alexander (no direct damage inflicted), Godfrey Icon (cannot be charged), or Old Lord's Talisman (affects only sorceries and incantations). Frequently equipped onto lightweight utility sidearms (such as a Dagger) to allow characters without Faith investment to obtain the Golden Vow aura.

name: Ash Of War: Gravitas
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Gravitas: Skill originating from the Alabaster Lords, who had skin of stone. Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in."

Usable on all melee armaments (small armaments and whips excepted).
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Gravitas skill. Costs 13 FP to activate.

Attack Sequence & Mechanics:
- The wielder stabs their weapon into the ground, generating a 360-degree gravitational shockwave that rapidly draws surrounding enemies inward before collapsing.
- The animation consists of two damage components: an initial physical weapon thrust into the ground (which can be parried in PvP), followed by an unparriable magic damage gravity wave.
- Pull & Knockdown: Pulls grounded human-sized and light combatants directly toward the user. Knocks flying and hovering enemies (such as Warhawks, bats, and dragonflies) out of the air onto the ground. Skeletons and certain undead are conversely pushed backward.
- Stance Damage: Deals 26 stance damage in PvE.
- Bonus Damage: Deals +20% bonus damage against gravity-type enemies (Astel, Fallingstar Beasts, Alabaster Lords, Onyx Lords, and Malformed Stars).

Armament Compatibility:
- Usable on all standard melee weapon classes, excluding small armaments (daggers, claws, fists) and whips.

Scaling & Synergies:
- The shockwave deals pure Magic damage that scales with weapon upgrade level and the character's Intelligence attribute.
- Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
- Boosted by Magic Scorpion Charm (+12% PvE / +8% PvP) and Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%).
- Boosted by Rogier's Spellblade Set (+2% damage per armor piece, up to +8% total for the complete set).
- Cannot be charged; does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Ground Slam
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Ground Slam: Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends a powerful shockwave in all directions."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity and the Ground Slam skill. Costs 14 FP per activation.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments without category restrictions.

• Attack Sequence & Mechanics: The user leaps vertically high into the air, briefly evading low-sweeping attacks, before crashing hips-first down into the earth. The impact inflicts direct physical damage to foes directly beneath the landing point and immediately unleashes a 360-degree radial ground shockwave that deals secondary physical damage and knocks down or staggers surrounding enemies. Humanoid targets hit directly are flattened to the ground.

• Stance Damage & Poise: Inflicts massive stance damage—approximately 30 stance damage on direct impact and 15 stance damage from the expanding shockwave, totaling up to 45 stance damage when both connect. Grants heavy hyper armor during descent and impact, enabling reliable damage trades.

• Damage Scaling: Scales with weapon upgrade level and total Attack Rating (AR), scaling primarily with Strength under the Heavy affinity. Auxiliary status build-up and weapon damage affinities apply on the direct strike, whereas the shockwave deals purely physical impact damage.

• Talisman Synergies: Directly boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Does not benefit from Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged, nor Claw Talisman as it is categorized as a skill rather than a jumping attack. Synergizes exceptionally well with the Dagger Talisman due to its rapid posture-breaking capabilities setting up critical ripostes.

name: Ash Of War: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker: Slam both hands onto the ground to violently shake the earth and unleash a shockwave. Follow up with an additional input to slam the ground again.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Grants the Heavy affinity by default. Costs 16 FP for the initial roar and slam, with an optional follow-up input costing an additional 16 FP (32 FP total). Usable on all melee armaments regardless of weapon class. Upon activation, the user emits a deafening roar that inflicts minor physical damage and staggers nearby foes, immediately followed by slamming both fists onto the terrain to radiate a wide-area concussive shockwave; pressing the skill input again executes a second ground slam and shockwave. Delivers exceptional stance damage: 15 from the initial roar, 20 from the first slam shockwave, and 20 from the follow-up slam shockwave, totaling 55 stance damage across the entire sequence. The skill grants heavy hyper armor throughout its startup and slam animations, preventing interruption from standard attacks, and is unparryable. Damage scales directly with character Strength and weapon upgrade level. Fully enhanced by Shard of Alexander and triggers consecutive attack buffs (Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, Godskin Swaddling Cloth), but does not benefit from Roar Medallion or Godfrey Icon as it cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Holy Ground
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Holy Ground: Raise shield to create an Erdtree-consecrated area that continuously restores HP and boosts defense for self and allies inside it."

Usable on all shields.
effects:
Grants the Sacred affinity (adds Faith scaling and Holy damage while adjusting physical attributes) and the Holy Ground skill.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on all shield categories (Small Shields, Medium Shields, and Greatshields).
• FP Cost: 30 FP.
• Skill Execution & Behavior: The user raises their shield to consecrate a circular area of golden light on the ground lasting 35 seconds. While standing within this zone, the user and all friendly summons/allies continuously recover 17 HP per second (totaling ~595 HP over the duration) and receive a +20% boost to all damage negations (Physical, Magic, Fire, Lightning, and Holy).
• Stacking & Positional Mechanics: Functions as an independent ground-based area buff; stacks multiplicatively with body buffs (such as Boiled Crab or Black Flame's Protection), aura buffs (such as Golden Vow), and ongoing health regeneration incantations (such as Bestial Vitality or Blessing's Boon). The defensive and restorative effects apply only while positioned within the boundary of the ring and fade immediately upon leaving.
• Damage, Scaling, & Stance: Strictly non-offensive utility; deals no direct attack damage, inflicts 0 stance damage, and causes no status buildup. The HP recovery rate and +20% damage negation are flat modifiers that do not scale with weapon reinforcement level or character Faith.
• Synergies & Talismans: FP consumption is reduced from 30 FP to 23 FP by the Carian Filigreed Crest. Does not benefit from Old Lord's Talisman (which affects only spells), Shard of Alexander (due to dealing no damage), or Godfrey Icon (skill cannot be charged).

name: Ash Of War: Hoarfrost Stomp
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

"Hoarfrost Stomp: Stomp hard to spread a trail of freezing mist on the ground. The mist applies the frost status effect."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Cold affinity, adding Magic damage, Intelligence scaling, and innate Frostbite buildup to the armament.

Skill Mechanics:
- FP Cost: 10 FP.
- Attack Sequence: The user stomps the ground, projecting an expanding conical trail of freezing mist forward across terrain. Shortly after propagation, jagged ice crystals erupt along the path and shatter, creating a secondary delayed area-of-effect damage wave.
- Damage Type & Scaling: Deals 100% pure Magic damage. Base damage scales with the armament's upgrade level (+0 to +25 / +10), with statutory scaling determined primarily by weapon Intelligence scaling (optimized via Cold or Magic affinity), alongside secondary contribution from weapon Strength and Dexterity scaling. Does not scale directly with weapon physical attack rating (AR).
- Status Buildup: Inflicts heavy Frostbite buildup (70 on initial mist contact, 110 on ice crystal eruption), triggering rapid Frostbite procs that inflict percentage max-HP damage and reduce target damage negation by 20% for 30 seconds.
- Stance Damage: Deals 0 stance damage (cannot trigger stance breaks on bosses), but possesses low-level stagger capable of interrupting light enemy actions.
- Weapon Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments (swords, daggers, axes, polearms, hammers, colossals, whips, fists, and claws). Incompatible with ranged weapons, shields, torches, and catalysts.
- Synergies: Enhanced by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage), Warrior Jar Shard (+10% skill damage), Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20% Magic damage), and the Spellblade Set (+2% Magic skill damage per armor piece, up to +8% total). Resetting Frostbite with any source of Fire damage allows continuous reapplication of proc damage. This skill cannot be charged and does not benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Ice Spear
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

"Ice Spear: Skill of the warriors who served Lunar Princess Ranni. Spin armament to release cold magic, then channel it into a piercing spear of ice."

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, and twinblades.
effects:
Grants the Cold affinity, adding Intelligence scaling and passive Frostbite build-up while modifying base physical damage and attribute scaling.

Skill: Ice Spear
• FP Cost: 15 FP.
• Attack Sequence: Spins the armament rapidly before launching a high-velocity projectile of ice straight ahead. At point-blank range, the spinning windup and the ice projectile can hit simultaneously for combined damage.
• Damage Type & Scaling: Deals pure Magic damage. Skill damage scales primarily with weapon upgrade level and Dexterity, receiving additional scaling from Intelligence (especially effective with Cold or Magic infusions). Does not scale with Strength.
• Stance Damage: Deals 25 stance damage in PvE from the projectile, with an additional ~10 stance damage from the melee spin if it connects at close quarters, enabling rapid stance breaks against elite foes and bosses in 3–4 casts.
• Status Effect: Inflicts heavy Frostbite buildup on both the physical weapon spin and the ice spear projectile.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on twinblades and polearms capable of thrusting (Spears, Great Spears, and thrusting Halberds).
• Synergies: Damage is boosted by the Shard of Alexander (+15%), Magic Scorpion Charm (+12%), Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%), and each piece of the Spellblade Set (+2% per piece, up to +8%). Skill cost can be reduced to 12 FP with Carian Filigreed Crest. The skill cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Impaling Thrust
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Impaling Thrust: Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard."

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
