Consumes 9 FP. The user pulls back their armament to concentrate force before driving forward in a swift, elongated lunging thrust. The attack pierces through enemy guards, bypassing approximately 85% of shield damage negation while dealing substantial stamina damage.

• Stance Damage: Inflicts 18 poise damage with Daggers and Claws; 24 with Thrusting Swords; 30 with Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, and Halberds; and 33 with Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, and Great Spears.
• Damage & Motion Value: Possesses an approximate 187% weapon attack power motion value, dealing pure Pierce damage that fully triggers thrust counter-attack bonuses.
• Status Buildup: Applies 100% of weapon-intrinsic or affinity-applied status buildup (e.g., Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison).
• Compatibility: Equippable on thrust-capable weapons including Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Claws, Light Greatswords, Great Katanas, and Thrusting Shields (colossal armaments excepted).
• Synergies: Skill damage is enhanced by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Thrust counter hits gain +15% damage from the Spear Talisman. FP cost is decreased from 9 to 7 with the Carian Filigreed Crest. Ineligible for Godfrey Icon as it cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Kick
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Kick: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.

Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
FP Cost: 0.

Executes a swift front-thrusting kick with the lead leg. Pushes smaller foes back and deals 6 base stance damage against unblocked targets. Its primary function is punishing guarding opponents: the kick deals massive stamina damage against blocking shields, frequently triggering an immediate guard break against small and medium shields and severely depleting Greatshield stamina to expose enemies to critical ripostes.

Compatible with all melee armaments without restriction (Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Great Katanas, Twinblades, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Axes, Greataxes, Hammers, Flails, Great Hammers, Colossal Weapons, Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Reapers, Fists, Claws, Whips, Hand-to-Hand Arts, and Thrusting Shields).

Damage scales with weapon upgrade level and Strength scaling (or the chosen affinity). Benefits from the Shattered Stone Talisman (+15% kick damage) and Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage). Synergizes directly with the Hammer Talisman for even higher stamina depletion against shields, and the Dagger Talisman to capitalize on resulting stance breaks with fatal critical attacks. Cannot be charged and receives no benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Lightning Ram
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

"Lightning Ram: Skill inspired by tumbling rams. Let out a bleat, then tumble forwards, clad in lightning. Tumbles can be repeated in rapid succession."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Lightning affinity, adding Lightning damage and Dexterity scaling while reducing base physical attack and Strength scaling. Imbues the armament with the skill Lightning Ram:

• FP Cost: 5 FP for the initial roll, consuming an additional 5 FP per subsequent tumble.
• Attack Sequence: The user lets out an audible ram bleat and curls forward into an electrified rolling tumble, hitting targets continuously along the trajectory. Pressing or holding the skill input chains continuous tumbles until FP or stamina depletes. The curled tumbling animation lowers the user's hitbox profile, allowing them to pass underneath certain high-altitude horizontal swings.
• Armament Compatibility: Compatible with all melee armaments.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals predominantly Lightning damage with minor Physical damage. Damage scales primarily with the weapon's upgrade level and Dexterity stat.
• Stance Damage: Inflicts approximately 6 stance damage per rolling impact.
• Hyper Armor & Poise: Provides minimal skill-based hyper armor; interruption resistance relies almost entirely on the user's passive armor poise. Incoming medium or heavy strikes will stagger the user out of the roll.
• Status Buildup: Hitboxes are generated by the rolling shockwave rather than direct weapon strikes; consequently, innate weapon auxiliary statuses (Bleed, Poison, Frost, Scarlet Rot) do not apply on hit.
• Synergies: Skill damage is boosted by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard (+15% / +10%), and Lightning damage is amplified by the Lightning Scorpion Charm (+12% PvE / +8% PvP) and Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20%). Consecutive hits rapidly trigger successive attack buffs including Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, Thorny Cracked Tear, and the healing effect of Godskin Swaddling Cloth. Unaffected by the Godfrey Icon (skill cannot be charged), and does not trigger Briar set passive roll damage.

name: Ash Of War: Lightning Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

Lightning Slash: Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock. The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers.
effects: Calls down a bolt of lightning onto the weapon before slamming it down in a powerful strike that releases an explosive electrical shockwave. FP cost is 10. Imbues the armament with an additional +85 flat lightning damage for 40 seconds upon completion. The downward physical strike scales with weapon upgrade level and physical attributes, while the lightning bolt and shockwave scale with Dexterity. Inflicts 17 to 30 stance damage depending on weapon class. Usable on swords, axes, hammers, and flails capable of skill alteration (including daggers, straight swords, greatswords, colossal swords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, twinblades, thrusting swords, heavy thrusting swords, axes, greataxes, hammers, and great hammers). Synergizes with Shard of Alexander and Lightning Scorpion Charm; cannot be charged with Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Lifesteal Fist
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

"Lifesteal Fist: Skill that perfuses the fist with energy to deliver a slow, controlled punch. Renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build."

Usable on fists and claws.
effects:
Grants the Occult affinity. Performs a slow, energy-infused forward punch that executes an unblockable grab against human-sized opponents and humanoid targets.

• FP Cost: 14 FP (FP is consumed only upon a successful grab; whiffs consume 0 FP).
• Health Restoration: Restores 30% of the player's maximum HP upon successfully executing the grab.
• Behavior & Knockdown: Renders the target temporarily unconscious during the drain animation and slams them to the floor, leaving them vulnerable on wakeup. Bypasses standard shields and guards.
• Target Limitation: Only functions against enemies of human build (e.g., enemy Tarnished, humanoid invaders, humanoid soldiers). Large beasts, monstrosities, and non-human bosses cannot be grabbed.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Fists and Claws (as well as Beast Claws and Hand-to-Hand Arts).
• Damage Scaling: Damage scales with weapon level and stats, scaling strongly with Arcane under the Occult affinity.
• Synergies: Attack damage is boosted by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard. Healing scales directly with total HP pool, synergizing with the Crimson Amber Medallion and Erdtree's Favor.

name: Ash Of War: Lion's Claw
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Lion's Claw: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament."

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (excluding small armaments and thrusting swords).
effects: Performs an acrobatic forward somersault and delivers a crushing overhead strike. Deals heavy physical damage (~2.4x weapon AR) and exceptional stance damage (6.0x multiplier, dealing 30–45 poise damage based on weapon class). Grants near-unbreakable hyper armor starting from frame 1, allowing the user to trade through most incoming attacks without being staggered. Applies 100% of the weapon's innate or infused status buildup on hit. Costs 20 FP per use. Compatible with swords, axes, and hammers (excluding daggers, thrusting swords, and claws). Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%); cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Loretta's Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Loretta's Slash: Skill of Loretta the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash."

Usable on polearms and twinblades.
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and skill Loretta's Slash. Costs 14 FP per activation.

Armament Compatibility: Usable on polearms (spears, great spears, halberds, reapers) and twinblades.

Attack Sequence & Mechanics:
Executes a fluid leaping maneuver where the user surges forward, coats the weapon in shimmering glintstone sorcery, and descends into an accelerating, wide-radius sweeping arc. The maneuver hits twice across a single execution: an initial strike on the ascending leap, followed by the main sweeping slash upon touching down. Offers generous hyper armor during the jump animation, allowing the wielder to absorb poise hits from lighter attacks, as well as airborne evasive utility over low ground sweeps.

Stance Damage & Status Buildup:
Inflicts a total of approximately 22 base stance damage when both components connect (~12 on the rising strike, ~10 on the descending slash). Auxiliary status buildup present on the armament (such as Frostbite, Bleed, or Poison) applies across both physical weapon contacts.

Damage Scaling:
Deals hybrid physical and magic damage. The physical portion scales with armament upgrade level and the weapon's Strength/Dexterity scalings, while the magic damage scales primarily with weapon upgrade level and Intelligence.

Key Synergies:
- Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Increases skill attack power by 15% / 10%.
- Magic Scorpion Charm: Increases magic damage dealt by 12% (8% in PvP).
- Spellblade Armor Set: Boosts magic skill damage by 2% per piece (up to 8% total).
- Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Increases all magic damage by 20% for 3 minutes.
- Godfrey Icon does not apply as this skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Mighty Shot
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Standard affinity and the following skill:

"Mighty Shot: Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard."

Usable on light bows and longbows.
effects: Grants the Standard affinity and the Mighty Shot skill. Weapon Skill Mechanics: Costs 6 FP per shot (0 FP to assume the oblique stance; FP is consumed only when the arrow is released). Readies the bow in an angled posture and draws the string back fully to loose a concentrated, high-velocity arrow. Movement speed is slowed and stamina recovery is reduced by 80% while holding the stance. The shot deals roughly +75% increased damage over standard shots, gains increased effective projectile range with delayed gravity drop-off, and partially bypasses enemy shield blocking (dealing approximately 50% piercing chip damage through guards). Status ailment buildup applied via status arrows (e.g., Poison, Blood, Sleep, Frostbite, Scarlet Rot) is increased by approximately +75%. Compatible with Light Bows and Longbows (ineligible for Greatbows and Crossbows). Damage scales with weapon upgrade level, arrow type, and armament attribute scaling. Synergizes with Shard of Alexander (boosting skill damage) and Arrow's Sting Talisman (boosting projectile damage), while Arrow's Reach Talisman extends its effective maximum range. Ineligible for Godfrey Icon charging enhancements.

name: Ash Of War: No Skill
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament and replaces any skill present with the following:

No Skill
This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

Usable on shields and torches.
effects:
Grants the Standard affinity by default and strips any innate weapon skill from the equipped armament, costing 0 FP.

• Armament Compatibility: Usable on Small Shields, Medium Shields, Greatshields, Thrusting Shields, and Torches.
• Mechanical Utility: Removes default weapon skills (such as Parry or Shield Bash), allowing the player to immediately trigger their main-hand armament's weapon skill with the skill button (L2/LT) while continuing to guard or hold illumination in the off-hand, without needing to two-hand the main weapon.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals no direct damage, inflicts no stance damage, and does not alter the base scaling or physical defense statistics of the armament.
• Affinity Modification: When applied with appropriate Whetblades, compatible shields can take on elemental or physical affinities while still retaining the No Skill functionality.

name: Ash Of War: Piercing Fang
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Piercing Fang: Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter. Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked."

Usable on medium and large armaments capable of thrusting.
effects: Costs 16 FP to execute. The user assumes a horizontal stance with the weapon before executing an extended, high-velocity lunging thrust with strong forward momentum and tracking. The thrust possesses 100% shield bypass, ignoring enemy guards and dealing full damage directly through active blocks. Compatible with medium and large thrusting weapons, including Straight Swords, Light Greatswords, Greatswords, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Great Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Great Spears, and Halberds (excludes Daggers, Throwing Blades, and Colossal Weapons). Deals physical Pierce damage with approximately 212% motion value, scaling with the weapon's level and affinity scaling attributes. Inflicts significant stance damage upon hit (24 on Thrusting Swords; 30 on Straight Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, and Halberds; 36 on Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, and Great Spears). Applies full base status accumulation on hit. Fully boosted by Shard of Alexander and gains substantial thrust counter-attack bonus damage when paired with the Spear Talisman (cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from the Godfrey Icon).

name: Ash Of War: Parry
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Parry: Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

Usable on daggers, curved swords, thrusting swords, fists, claws, and small and medium shields.
effects: Costs 0 FP. Compatible with daggers, curved swords, thrusting swords, fists, claws, small shields, and medium shields. When timed against an incoming parriable enemy melee attack, deflects the blow and immediately breaks the opponent's stance, exposing standard enemies to a critical riposte. Certain elite foes and bosses require consecutive parries (typically 2 to 3) to trigger a stance break. At 60 FPS, parry frame data varies by armament class: small shields, medium shields, thrusting swords, fists, and claws feature 8 startup frames and 12 active parry frames; daggers feature 6 startup frames and 10 active frames; curved swords feature 6 startup frames and 8 active frames. Partial parries consume increased stamina and mitigate damage according to the armament's damage negation. Deals no direct damage or status buildup, receiving no benefit from skill damage enhancers like Shard of Alexander, but directly synergizes with critical damage accessories such as the Dagger Talisman, Assassin's Crimson Dagger, and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger.

name: Ash Of War: Poisonous Mist
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:

"Poisonous Mist: Bathe armament in poison, and then slash, spreading toxic mist forwards. The armament retains its poison for a while."

Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
effects: Costs 14 FP to execute. The wielder coats the armament in venom while executing a sweeping horizontal slash and discharging a lingering cloud of toxic green mist ahead. The slash deals direct weapon damage and 12 stance damage, while the mist inflicts 120 base poison buildup per tick over roughly 2 seconds. Executing the skill enchants the weapon for 40 seconds with a poison buff, adding 60 flat poison buildup to weapon strikes. Both the mist and the weapon coating's status buildup scale with the Arcane attribute if the weapon possesses Arcane scaling (such as Poison or Occult affinities). Usable on all melee armaments except whips, fists, and claws. Synergizes directly with Kindred of Rot's Exultation and the Mushroom Crown to trigger substantial attack power bonuses upon poison procs. The slash attack's damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander.

name: Ash Of War: Prayerful Strike
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Prayerful Strike: Raise armament aloft in prayer, then slam it into the ground. This inspired blow restores HP to the self and nearby allies if it successfully hits."

Usable on axes and hammers.
effects: Grants the Sacred affinity (adds Holy damage and Faith scaling) and the Prayerful Strike skill. Costs 20 FP to execute. The wielder holds their weapon high in prayer to coat it in golden holy energy before slamming it down into the earth. The animation features substantial hyper armor / poise during startup and delivery, allowing the user to trade blows reliably against heavy attacks. Upon successfully striking an enemy, the impact restores 30% of maximum HP to the user and nearby allies (triggering per enemy struck if multi-target hits land). Deals heavy physical and holy damage alongside high stance damage (~33-36 stance damage depending on weapon weight), knocking down or flattening standard human-sized targets and breaking enemy posture rapidly. Compatible with Axes, Greataxes, Hammers, Great Hammers, Flails, and Colossal Weapons (excluding Colossal Swords). Fully boosted by Shard of Alexander and Sacred Scorpion Charm; synergies notably well with naturally vampiric weapons like Great Stars to maximize HP restoration.

name: Ash Of War: Phantom Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Phantom Slash: Skill inspired by the fond remembrances of the Night's Cavalry. Creates an apparition of the knights' former instructor who guides a joint lunging upward swing. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."

Usable on polearms and twinblades (great spears excepted).
effects:
Consumes 8 FP for the initial skill activation and 8 FP for the follow-up attack (16 FP total).

Compatible exclusively with polearms (Halberds, Spears, Reapers) and Twinblades; Great Spears and other weapon types are excluded.

Upon activation, summons a spectral apparition of the Night's Cavalry instructor that lunges forward to execute an upward sweeping slash, followed immediately by the player performing an identical lunging slash. Inputting an additional skill command prompts both the phantom and player to follow through with a heavy downward slamming strike in rapid succession.

Deals 18 stance damage during the initial stage (9 from the phantom strike and 9 from the player strike), with the follow-up combo dealing additional stance damage.

Damage scales with the weapon's attack rating and scaling stats (Strength and Dexterity under Quality affinity, or the respective scaling stats under alternate infusions). Consecutive strikes trigger multi-hit mechanics, building up weapon-borne status effects such as Blood Loss or Frostbite efficiently.

Skill damage is augmented by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard. Continuous attacks synergize with successive-hit boosting equipment including Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Winged Sword Insignia, and Millicent's Prosthesis. Cannot be charged, rendering it unaffected by the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Poison Moth Flight
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:

"Poison Moth Flight: Slash with a poison-infused blade. If the follow-up strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significant damage."

Usable on small and medium swords (twinblades excepted).
effects:
FP Cost: 7.

Skill Execution & Mechanics:
- Attack Sequence: The user lunges forward into a sweeping slash infused with toxic green mist and moths. The strike inflicts direct physical weapon damage and an immediate burst of 250 Poison buildup.
- Poison Detonation: When the strike lands on an enemy already afflicted with the poison status effect, it detonates and removes the poison, dealing an instantaneous burst of bonus damage equal to 250 flat damage plus 5% of the target's maximum HP. Clearing the status allows poison accumulation to begin anew immediately, circumventing the standard duration waiting period.
- Status Interaction: Only detonates standard poison; it does not consume or detonate Scarlet Rot.
- Stance Damage: Deals 9 stance damage in PvE.

Armament Compatibility:
- Usable on small and medium swords: Daggers, Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Thrusting Swords, and Katanas (Twinblades excepted).

Scaling & Synergies:
- Damage Scaling: Physical strike damage scales with weapon upgrade level and character attack power. The detonation bonus (250 flat + 5% max HP) is fixed percentage-based damage.
- Synergies: Augmented by Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage). Highly synergetic with Kindred of Rot's Exultation (+20% attack power) and Mushroom Crown (+10% attack power); consuming active poison allows continuous re-infliction to maintain permanent buff uptime. The skill cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Quickstep
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Quickstep: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Keen affinity by default, enhancing Dexterity scaling while decreasing base physical damage and Strength scaling. Executes a rapid, low-profile evasive dash with negligible recovery delay.

• Resource Cost: Consumes 3 FP (reduced to 2 FP with Carian Filigreed Crest) and 12 Stamina per use. Can be executed at 0 FP, which increases stamina consumption to 18 Stamina.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments without restriction (including daggers, straight swords, greatswords, colossal swords, curved swords, katanas, thrusting swords, axes, hammers, spears, halberds, scythes, whips, fists, claws, and thrusting shields).
• Invulnerability & Frame Data: Provides 15 invulnerability frames on the initial dash (at 30 FPS / 30 frames at 60 FPS). Successive chained dashes grant 13 i-frames (increased to 14 i-frames under Light Equip Load). At 0 FP, invulnerability drops sharply to 5 i-frames. Retains full mobility even when Overloaded and allows rapid movement through movement-impairing terrain such as lava or deep mire.
• Maneuver Sequence & Attack Flow: Enables omnidirectional dodging; when locked onto an opponent, sideways and backwards inputs sweep tightly along the target's flank, creating backstab opportunities. Executing a light attack during or immediately following the dash transitions directly into the armament's designated rolling/backstep attack.
• Damage & Stance Damage: Deals no damage or stance damage on its own; scaling and posture impact are governed entirely by subsequent weapon strikes.
• Status Buildup: Inflicts no innate status effects; preserves any status build-up properties native to the equipped armament or applied weapon coatings.
• Talisman Synergies: Pairs effectively with Carian Filigreed Crest for reduced FP cost, and Dagger Talisman or Assassin's Crimson/Cerulean Dagger to capitalize on frequent backstabs. Shard of Alexander and Godfrey Icon have no effect as the skill possesses no attack hitbox and cannot be charged. Crucible Feather Talisman does not enhance Quickstep i-frames.

name: Ash Of War: Raptor Of The Mists
description:
Grants an armament the Keen affinity and the Raptor of the Mists skill.

Raptor of the Mists: Drop into a low evasive crouch, momentarily vanishing. Should an enemy strike connect, raven wings will deploy to carry the wielder swiftly upward into the air.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Keen affinity, increasing Dexterity scaling while reducing Strength scaling and base weapon damage.

Skill Mechanics:
- FP Cost: 0 FP to assume the crouch stance; 6 FP consumed only when an incoming attack connects and triggers the airborne counter-leap.
- Armament Compatibility: Usable on all melee armaments (swords, daggers, colossal weapons, curved swords, katanas, twinblades, axes, hammers, flails, spears, halberds, reapers, whips, fists, and claws). Incompatible with shields and ranged armaments.
- Evasion Behavior: Upon activation, the wielder ducks into a low crouch for approximately 0.75 seconds. If an enemy attack or environmental strike connects during this window, hit damage is completely negated, and avian wings launch the player straight up into the air. Also negates environmental hazards such as Hero's Grave chariots.
- Attack Sequence: While airborne, the user can immediately transition into aerial offensive moves, including light jump attacks (R1), heavy jump attacks (R2), or dual-wield jump attacks (L1).
- Damage & Stance Damage: The evasion skill itself inflicts no damage or posture damage. All damage and stance poise break correspond directly to the equipped weapon's jump attack values.
- Status Buildup & Vulnerabilities: Incoming status buildup (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot) from the triggering blow still accumulates even though damage is negated. Grab attacks cannot be avoided.
- Key Synergies: Combines with jumping attack boosts such as the Claw Talisman (+15% jump attack damage) and the Raptor's Black Feathers armor (+10% jump attack damage). Does not benefit from Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon, as the follow-up strike counts as a normal jump attack rather than skill damage.

name: Ash Of War: Rain Of Arrows
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Standard affinity and the following skill:

"Rain of Arrows: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire a burst of arrows into the sky to shower the enemy with projectiles."

Usable on all bows.
effects: Grants the Standard affinity. Costs 20 FP to activate. Usable on all bows, including Light Bows, standard Bows, and Greatbows. The user assumes a grounded low stance and fires a cluster of arrows skyward, unleashing a concentrated barrage that rains down onto the targeted area after a brief delay. Each individual arrow inflicts approximately 50% of standard shot damage, but the cumulative volley of arrows yields tremendous total physical damage, high stance pressure, and rapid status effect application (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot depending on the equipped ammunition). Highly effective against large targets and bosses where the majority of arrows connect. The skill's damage is boosted by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard, while Arrow's Sting Talisman enhances the individual projectile attack power and Arrow's Reach Talisman extends target acquisition distance. Not chargeable, so it does not benefit from the Godfrey Icon. Blocked by indoor ceilings and overhangs.

name: Ash Of War: Repeating Thrust
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Repeating Thrust: Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).
effects: Consumes 7 FP to execute. The user twists backward into a primed stance before unleashing a flurry of four rapid, forward-driving thrusts in quick succession. All strikes deal Pierce physical damage and can trigger counter damage bonuses against foes mid-attack. Across the entire attack sequence, it inflicts approximately 14 to 15 total stance damage (~3.75 stance damage per thrust). Each individual strike applies a reduced status buildup multiplier (~50% per strike, totaling ~200% buildup if all four hits land), allowing for extremely rapid application of Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot on status-infused armaments. Compatible with all thrust-capable armaments excluding Colossal Weapons (including Daggers, Straight Swords, Greatswords, Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Twinblades, Spears, Great Spears, Halberds, Light Greatswords, Great Katanas, Throwing Blades, and Thrusting Shields). Synergizes exceptionally well with consecutive-attack effects (Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, Thorny Cracked Tear), heal-on-hit effects (Godskin Swaddling Cloth), pierce counter boosters (Spear Talisman), and skill damage enhancers (Shard of Alexander, Warrior Jar Shard). This skill cannot be charged, and therefore does not benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Royal Knight's Resolve
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Royal Knight's Resolve: Skill of the knights who once served the Elden Lord. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, greatly powering up your next attack.

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Grants the Quality affinity by default. Consumes 15 FP to execute a rapid oath animation, infusing the weapon with a luminous glow lasting 10 seconds or until an attack successfully connects. Greatly amplifies the total damage of the next attack by +80% in PvE (+40% against players in PvP) across all physical and elemental damage types, with critical hits and ripostes receiving a +35% damage boost. Compatible with all melee armament classes. Does not alter base stance damage, poise damage values, or status buildup. Multiplicatively stacks with body buffs (Flame, Grant Me Strength, Howl of Shabriri), aura buffs (Golden Vow), and attack modifier talismans (Claw Talisman, Axe Talisman, Dagger Talisman). Does not receive bonuses from Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon, and its duration cannot be extended by Old Lord's Talisman.

name: Ash Of War: Sacred Ring Of Light
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Sacred Ring of Light: Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, and then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession."

Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).
effects: Grants the Sacred affinity, adding Holy damage and Faith scaling to the armament while reducing base physical damage, and permanently puts down Those Who Live in Death. When activating the skill (9 FP), the user forms a ring of holy light at the blade or tip of the weapon and hurls it forward as a projectile. Repeated inputs allow consecutive rings to be fired in rapid succession. The projectile deals pure Holy damage, scaling with weapon upgrade level and the character's Faith attribute. It inflicts modest stance damage (~3 stance damage per hit). Usable on polearms including Spears, Halberds, and Reapers (excluding Great Spears). Damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander, Sacred Scorpion Charm, and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear; it cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Sacred Blade
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Sacred Blade: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for a while."

Usable on all melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
effects: Grants the Sacred affinity (adds Holy damage and Faith scaling while reducing base physical damage). Imbues the weapon with holy light and swings forward to launch a golden crescent projectile that travels forward, costing 19 FP. At point-blank range, both the weapon swing and the projectile hit simultaneously for combined damage. Activation coats the armament in holy essence for 40 seconds, granting a flat +90 Holy attack power buff to weapon attacks. Projectiles and buffed strikes permanently defeat Those Who Live in Death, preventing their reanimation. The projectile deals 6 stance damage and its damage scales with weapon upgrade level and Faith. Boosted by Shard of Alexander, Sacred Scorpion Charm, and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear (cannot be charged; Godfrey Icon does not apply).

name: Ash Of War: Sacred Order
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Sacred Order: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Grants the Sacred affinity (adds Faith scaling and Holy damage while adjusting base physical damage). Imbues the weapon with the Sacred Order skill for 18 FP. Upon activation, the wielder executes a brief formal salute, enveloping the armament in holy energy for 60 seconds. While active, the buff grants a +10% boost to all damage dealt (+2.5% in PvP) and an additional +100% damage multiplier against Those Who Live in Death (skeletons, Deathbirds, Tibia Mariners), completely preventing reviving undead from resurrecting. Applicable to all melee armament types. Because the skill functions as a self/weapon enhancement rather than a direct strike, it does not inflict direct stance damage or status buildup on cast, nor does it benefit from charge enhancements like the Godfrey Icon. However, the Holy damage component is augmented by the Sacred Scorpion Charm and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

name: Ash Of War: Seppuku
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

"Seppuku: A forbidden technique used by swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Plunge the blade into your stomach to stain it with blood. Increases attack power and improves ability to inflict blood loss."

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (small and colossal weapons not included).
effects: Costs 4 FP and inflicts self-damage of 100 HP plus 15% of maximum HP upon activation. The user drives the armament into their own abdomen, coating the blade in blood for 60 seconds. Grants +30 flat physical attack power and adds +30 base blood loss buildup to the weapon, which scales further with the weapon's Arcane scaling. The self-inflicted impale immediately triggers a blood loss status confirmation on the wielder, instantly activating proximity hemorrhage synergies such as the Lord of Blood's Exultation talisman (+20% attack power for 20 seconds) and the White Mask helm (+10% attack power for 20 seconds). Possesses no offensive hitbox and deals no direct damage or stance damage to enemies upon execution. Does not benefit from Shard of Alexander, Godfrey Icon, or Old Lord's Talisman. Compatible with swords (straight swords, greatswords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, thrusting swords, and heavy thrusting swords) and thrust-capable polearms (twinblades, spears, great spears, and halberds); small armaments (daggers, claws, fists) and colossal weapons (colossal swords, colossal weapons) are excluded.

name: Ash Of War: Spinning Strikes
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Spinning Strikes: Polearm skill that performs continuous spinning attacks. Hold to continue the attack. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. Nullifies projectiles such as arrows while spinning."

Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).
effects:
Skill Mechanics & Behavior:
• FP Cost: 2 FP to activate and 2 FP per continuous spin loop; follow-up normal attack costs 10 FP; follow-up strong attack costs 15 FP.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on polearms, specifically Halberds, Spears, Twinblades, and Reapers (Scythes). Incompatible with Great Spears, swords, daggers, curved greatswords, axes, hammers, flails, colossal weapons, whips, fists, claws, and ranged weaponry.
• Attack Sequence:
 - Continuous Spin: Twirls the polearm continuously around the wielder in a wide horizontal arc. Holding down the skill button prolongs the spinning barrage as long as FP and stamina permit.
 - Normal Attack Follow-up (Light Attack): Seamlessly chains out of the spin into a rapid two-hit forward sweeping attack.
 - Strong Attack Follow-up (Heavy Attack): Transitions out of the spin into a forward lunge followed by a devastating overhead vertical slam.
• Projectile Deflection: While actively twirling the polearm, incoming light projectiles (such as arrows, crossbow bolts, and thrown daggers) colliding with the spin hitbox are deflected and nullified.
• Damage Scaling & Stance Damage:
 - Damage is strictly physical melee contact based directly on the armament's Attack Rating (AR), affinity, and weapon upgrade level.
 - Stance Damage: Deals 6 stance damage per spinning hit, 12 stance damage across the normal attack follow-up, and 16 stance damage on the strong attack finisher.
• Status Buildup & Synergies:
 - Inherits the armament's natural or infused status buildup (Bleed, Frost, Poison) as well as temporary weapon buffs (such as Bloodflame Blade or elemental greases). The rapid multi-hit property facilitates extremely rapid status infliction.
 - Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Directly increases the attack power of the spin and both follow-up strikes by 15% / 10%.
 - Consecutive Hit Synergies: Rapidly activates and sustains maximum tier attack bonuses from Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and Thorny Cracked Tear.
 - Godskin Swaddling Cloth: Quickly triggers successive hit HP restoration.
 - Godfrey Icon: Ineffective, as holding to sustain the loop does not count as a charged skill.

name: Ash Of War: Shield Crash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Standard affinity and the following skill:

"Shield Crash: Go down on one knee to steady your shield before charging forward, shoving foes backward. Weaker enemies can even be knocked off balance. Hold to extend the duration of the charge."

Usable on all shields.
effects:
Grants the Shield Crash skill and Standard affinity. Costs 12 FP to activate. Compatible with all shields (Small Shields, Medium Shields, and Greatshields).

Mechanics:
• Execution: The wielder grips the shield with both hands, drops low onto one knee, and rushes forward in a multi-hitting bull charge that concludes with a heavy finishing slam. Holding the skill input extends the charge distance and duration, delivering continuous contact hits.
• Guard Frames: Active blocking frames protect the wielder throughout the running charge and finishing blow, utilizing the shield's guard boost and damage negation stats. A brief window of vulnerability exists during the initial start-up kneeling animation prior to the rush.
• Stagger & Knockdown: Hits repeatedly stagger, shove, and knock down human-sized adversaries, dealing substantial cumulative stance damage across the entire sequence (approximately 27–30 total stance damage when all hits connect).
• Status Buildup: Each contact strike applies status effect buildup (e.g., Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison) scaled for multi-hit weapon skills, exhibiting exceptional synergy with status-inflicted shields such as the Spiked Palisade Shield and Fingerprint Stone Shield.
• Scaling & Synergies: Damage scales with the shield's upgrade reinforcement level, base physical attack rating, and attribute scaling associated with the chosen affinity. Skill damage is amplified by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard. It is not boosted by the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Spinning Slash
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).
effects: Consumes 6 FP for the initial activation and 12 FP for the follow-up attack (18 FP total). The user performs a rapid 360-degree spinning sweep attacking surrounding enemies; pressing the strong attack input immediately delivers a powerful secondary leap spin and downward slash. Compatible with swords, axes, and polearms (straight swords, curved swords, katanas, twinblades, greatswords, curved greatswords, thrusting swords, heavy thrusting swords, axes, greataxes, spears, great spears, halberds, and reapers; colossal weapons excluded). Damage scales directly with the weapon's attack rating and chosen affinity. Applies armament status buildup (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, or Poison) on every hit across the multi-hit sequence, making it exceptionally potent for status-inflicting builds. Deals respectable stance damage across all hits to stagger foes and break posture. Boosted by Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard; synergizes extraordinarily well with successive attack enhancers such as Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, and Millicent's Prosthesis. Cannot be charged, thus unaffected by Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Spectral Lance
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

"Spectral Lance: Skill of the headless Mausoleum Knights. Hurl a phantasmic spear at foes."

Usable on polearms (reapers excepted).
effects:
Grants the Occult affinity and the Spectral Lance skill.

• FP Cost: 9
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on polearms, including spears, great spears, halberds, and twinblades (reapers excepted).
• Attack Sequence: The wielder conjures and hurls a phantasmic spear forward in a straight trajectory over long ranges with light homing tracking. Deals Pierce physical damage and cannot be charged.
• Stance Damage: Deals 25 base stance damage on standard spears, halberds, and twinblades, and 27.5 base stance damage on great spears, making it an exceptional tool for breaking enemy posture and staggering bosses from a safe distance.
• Damage Scaling: Projectile damage scales primarily with weapon upgrade level and the character's Arcane attribute. While Occult affinity aligns the weapon's physical scaling with the skill, the projectile maintains Arcane scaling across any affinity infusion.
• Synergies & Mechanics:
 - Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%).
 - Projectile effective range before drop-off is increased by Arrow's Reach Talisman (Arrow's Sting Talisman does not boost damage).
 - Qualifies for thrusting counterattack damage boosted by Spear Talisman (+15%) when striking enemies mid-attack.
 - Can transfer effects from temporary weapon buffs (such as Black Flame Blade or Bloodflame Blade) to the projectile on impact.
 - Does not benefit from Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Spinning Weapon
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Spinning Weapon: Defensive skill employed by Carian princesses. Lifts armament into mid-air, then makes it spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive attacks."

Usable on small and medium swords, axes, and hammers, as well as polearms and staves (great spears excepted).
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Spinning Weapon skill. Costs 12 FP per activation.

Upon activation, the user telekinetically hovers the armament directly in front of them, spinning it violently at rapid speed in place before returning it to hand. The spinning blade delivers up to 7 successive close-range weapon-damage hits and creates a continuous defensive barrier that deflects light incoming physical projectiles such as arrows.

Damage scales directly from the weapon's Attack Power (AP) and attributes (primarily Intelligence when Magic-infused). Each contact hit deals approximately 2 stance damage (up to 14 total stance damage across an uninterrupted sequence). Status effect buildup (Bleed, Frost, Poison) is applied at a fraction per tick, enabling rapid status proc accumulation when used on status-inherent or buffed armaments.

Compatible with small and medium swords (daggers, straight swords, greatswords, curved swords, katanas, twinblades, thrusting swords), axes, hammers, polearms (spears, halberds, reapers), and glintstone staves (incompatible with colossal armaments, curved greatswords, greataxes, great hammers, great spears, flails, whips, fists, claws, and ranged weapons).

Synergizes strongly with Shard of Alexander, Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and Godskin Swaddling Cloth due to rapid successive hits. Cannot be charged, rendering Godfrey Icon ineffective.

name: Ash Of War: Square Off
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Square Off: This skill starts with a horizontal sword stance. Slash up through enemy guards with a normal attack, or run and thrust with a strong attack."

Usable on straight swords.
effects:
Compatible exclusively with Straight Swords.

Assumes a horizontal ready stance with the blade drawn forward, from which one of two distinct follow-up attacks can be executed:

• Light Attack (R1/RB) Follow-up (6 FP): Delivers a powerful upward slash that cuts through enemy blocks, dealing massive guard damage to break shields and inflicting 30 base stance damage.
• Heavy Attack (R2/RT) Follow-up (8 FP): Performs an aggressive lunging forward thrust that covers significant ground, inflicting pierce damage and dealing 40 base stance damage.

Damage scales with the weapon's overall attack power and affinity scaling. Both attacks benefit from weapon buff effects and apply weapon status buildups. Deals exceptional stance damage capable of breaking boss poise in 2 to 3 hits. Highly synergistic with Shard of Alexander, Rellana's Cameo, Dagger Talisman, and the Spear Talisman (for the heavy thrust counterattacks).

name: Ash Of War: Shield Bash
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Shield Bash: Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

Usable on all shields.
effects: Costs 10 FP to execute. The user braces firmly behind their shield and charges forward, slamming the face of the shield into targets while actively maintaining a guarding block for the duration of the lunge. Incoming enemy attacks that connect during the bash are blocked according to the shield's damage negation and Guard Boost stats, consuming stamina rather than health. Deals physical damage and high stance damage scaling directly with shield upgrade level, shield weight, and armament attribute scaling (primarily Strength). When applied to shields with innate status build-up (such as blood loss or poison) or elemental/status affinities, the bash applies full status build-up on impact. Deals heavy poise/stagger damage capable of knocking back lighter foes and breaking stances. Damage is boosted by the Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard; guard stability is enhanced by the Greatshield Talisman. Cannot be charged and does not benefit from Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Stamp (sweep)
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Stamp (Sweep): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for a sweeping strike."

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted).
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity and the Stamp (Sweep) weapon skill.

• FP Cost: 5 FP for the initial stance, plus 8 FP for the heavy follow-up attack (13 FP total).
• Attack Sequence: Press the skill button to assume a braced, low posture. While holding this stance, the user gains substantial hyper armor and a 50% damage negation buff against incoming attacks. Pressing the strong attack button (R2/RT) unleashes a wide horizontal 360-degree sweep that knocks down or staggers humanoid enemies. Pressing the light attack button exits the stance with a standard light attack.
• Armament Class Compatibility: Compatible with large swords, axes, and blunt weapons, including Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Greataxes, Axes, Hammers, Great Hammers, Flails, and Colossal Weapons. Excludes small and medium swords (Daggers, Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Twinblades), polearms, ranged weapons, and catalysts.
• Damage & Scaling: The skill damage scales directly with the weapon's total Attack Rating (AR) and upgrade level. The follow-up sweep deals approximately 215% of the weapon's base damage value.
• Stance Damage: Varies by weapon class—Axes deal 20 stance damage; Greatswords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, and Greataxes deal 22 stance damage; Hammers, Great Hammers, Flails, Colossal Swords, and non-hammer Colossal Weapons deal 24 stance damage; Colossal Hammers deal 26 stance damage.
• Status Buildup: Applies 100% of any weapon-innate or affinity-infused status effect buildup (such as Bleed, Poison, Frostbite, or Rot) on connection.
• Talisman Synergies: Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). Not boostable by Godfrey Icon since the skill cannot be charged. Stacking with damage negation or poise-boosting talismans (Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman, Bull-Goat's Talisman) enhances trade safety during the brace animation.

name: Ash Of War: Stamp (upward Cut)
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Stamp (Upward Cut): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike."

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted).
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity, tilting scaling heavily toward Strength while lowering base damage and other attribute scalings.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 5 FP for the initial stance brace; 8 additional FP upon executing the strong attack upward cut follow-up (13 FP total). Light attacks executed from the stance consume 0 FP.
• Stance & Defensive Attributes: Stepping into the low stance provides high hyper armor and 50% damage negation during the brace, allowing the user to absorb enemy attacks without staggering or suffering recoil.
• Upward Cut Follow-up: Pressing strong attack releases a rising strike that launches smaller and human-sized combatants into the air and inflicts substantial posture damage.
• Stance Damage: Varies by armament category—inflicts 30 stance damage on axes; 33 on greatswords, curved greatswords, greataxes, and heavy thrusting swords; 36 on colossal swords, flails, and bladed colossal weapons; 39 on hammers; 42 on great hammers; and 45 on colossal strike weapons.
• Damage & Status: Scales directly with the equipped weapon's Attack Rating (AR) and weapon upgrade level. Applies 100% of weapon auxiliary status buildup (e.g., Blood Loss, Frostbite, Poison) on hit.
• Armament Compatibility: Compatible with large swords, axes, and hammers (including Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Axes, Greataxes, Hammers, Great Hammers, Flails, and Colossal Weapons). Incompatible with small and medium swords (Daggers, Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Thrusting Swords, Katanas, Twinblades), as well as polearms, ranged weapons, and shields.
• Key Synergies: Boosted by Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard. Does not benefit from Godfrey Icon as the skill cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Stormcaller
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Stormcaller: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."

Usable on swords capable of slashing, axes, hammers, and polearms (small and colossal weapons excepted).
effects: Grants the Quality affinity and the Stormcaller skill. Costs 9 FP to initiate, with up to two subsequent follow-up inputs costing 11 FP each (totaling 31 FP for the entire three-stage combo). Upon execution, the wielder raises and spins the armament overhead, generating swirling storm winds that damage, stagger, and pull in nearby foes. The attack sequence consists of an initial rapid multi-hit spin followed by up to two additional extended spin cycles concluding in a ground strike. Deals physical damage that scales directly with the armament's Attack Rating (AR) and upgrade level, governed by weapon Strength and Dexterity scaling. Each physical swing and wind vortex hit inflicts stance damage (approximately 4 to 6 stance damage per tick, reaching over 30 total stance damage upon landing the entire combo sequence) and easily staggers humanoid enemies. Each weapon strike applies status buildup (bleed, poison, frost, or scarlet rot) at reduced per-hit efficiency, making it highly effective on status-infused weapons due to the high hit count. The wielder gains substantial hyper armor during spinning motions. Compatible with slashing swords (straight swords, greatswords, curved swords, curved greatswords, katanas, great katanas, twinblades), axes, greataxes, hammers, great hammers, flails, spears, great spears, halberds, and reapers; unusable on daggers, thrusting swords, and colossal weapons. Synergizes effectively with Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage) and multi-hit boosters such as Rotten Winged Sword Insignia and Millicent's Prosthesis. Does not benefit from Godfrey Icon as it cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Storm Stomp
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Storm Stomp: One of the skills that foster the storms of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary whirlwind."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Costs 6 FP. The user stomps firmly onto the ground to generate an immediate, localized vortex of turbulent storm wind in a 360-degree radius. Deals standard physical damage while granting hyper armor during startup. Inflicts severe hitstun and high poise damage against small-to-medium enemies and players, reliably creating true combo setups into subsequent light or heavy attacks with various weapon classes. Deals 15 stance damage against large enemies and bosses. Damage scales with weapon upgrade level, physical damage, and wielder attributes (primarily Strength and Dexterity). Damage and storm potency are boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%), Warrior Jar Shard (+10%), Enraged Divine Beast (+10%), and the Divine Beast Head (+4%). Compatible with all melee armaments.

name: Ash Of War: Storm Wall
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Standard affinity and the following skill:

"Storm Wall: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."

Usable on small and medium shields.
effects:
Grants the Standard affinity by default. Compatible exclusively with Small Shields and Medium Shields.

Skill: Storm Wall
FP Cost: 0
Stamina Cost: 10

Mechanics:
- Skill Execution: Swings the shield forward to generate a localized barrier of storm wind in front of the wielder. Deflects incoming physical projectiles, including arrows, bolts, greatbolts, and throwing daggers/pots.
- Melee Parry: Functions concurrently as a parry against parriable melee attacks. Standardizes parry frames across both small and medium shields to top-tier parry frame data (8 startup frames, 12 active parry frames at 60 FPS), equal to Carian Retaliation and Golden Parry without requiring FP consumption.
- Projectile Deflection: Active immediately from frame 0 for projectile redirection.
- Damage & Stance: Deals no direct damage or stance damage; successful deflection interrupts attacks and leaves foes vulnerable to a critical strike / riposte.
- Talisman Synergies: Synergizes with Dagger Talisman and Blade of Mercy for amplified riposte damage, as well as Assassin's Crimson Dagger and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger for HP/FP recovery on critical hits. Not boosted by Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon as the skill deals no inherent damage.

name: Ash Of War: Storm Assault
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Storm Assault: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact."

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.
effects:
Costs 22 FP per execution. Can be applied to thrusting polearms (Spears, Great Spears, thrusting Halberds), Heavy Thrusting Swords, Twinblades, and Thrusting Shields.

Execution & Hit Sequence:
The user gathers tempestuous gusts and leaps forward into the air, evading low-hitting attacks and ground hazard hitboxes while enveloped in two small swirling storm hitboxes that interrupt and stagger close targets. The user then plunges the weapon downward in a forceful piercing thrust, detonating an outward shockwave vortex of storm winds upon ground contact.

Damage & Scaling:
• Physical Thrust: Deals heavy physical thrust damage scaling directly with the armament's overall Attack Rating and weapon affinities. Capable of triggering Pierce counterattack bonus damage.
• Tempest Gusts & Impact Burst: Deals physical damage scaling with the weapon's upgrade level and Strength/Dexterity scaling attributes.

Status Buildup & Weapon Buffs:
The physical downward thrust applies 100% of weapon status effects (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, or Poison) and weapon coating/spell buffs (such as Bloodflame Blade or Scholar's Armament). Wind vortexes deal purely physical damage and do not apply weapon statuses or weapon buff overlays.

Poise & Stance Damage:
Provides substantial hyper armor during the aerial descent and plunge. Landing the full sequence (swirling winds, weapon thrust, and final blast) delivers heavy cumulative stance damage, routinely breaking enemy stances and flattening human-sized targets.

Synergies:
Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15%) and Warrior Jar Shard (+10%). The plunging thrust benefits from the Spear Talisman (+15% counterattack damage). As an unchargeable skill, it is not affected by Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Thops's Barrier
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Thops's Barrier: Erect a magical forcefield while swinging the shield to deflect sorceries and incantations. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."

Usable on small and medium shields.
effects:
Grants the Magic affinity and the Thops's Barrier skill. Usable on Small and Medium Shields.

• FP Cost: 0
• Stamina Cost: 10
• Skill Function: Swings the equipped shield to manifest a circular magic barrier that deflects hostile sorceries and incantations outward and away from the user, completely negating damage without consuming FP. Deflects both minor projectiles and powerful spells (including broad-area magic like Elden Stars).
• Parry Mechanics: Concurrently acts as a physical parry against parriable melee attacks, staggering enemies and exposing them to critical ripostes. Features 11 startup frames, 9 active parry/deflection frames, and 31 recovery frames (at 60 FPS), significantly improving the parry window and recovery speed of medium shields to match high-tier small shield parries.
• Stance & Status: Inflicts no status buildup and deals no direct damage. A successful parry interrupts enemy attack animations and accumulates toward the stance-break threshold of parriable bosses.
• Scaling: The Ash of War adds Magic damage and Intelligence scaling to the shield, reducing physical defense and Strength/Dexterity attributes unless altered with an appropriate Whetblade.
• Talisman Synergies: Shard of Alexander and Godfrey Icon offer no benefit since the skill deals no direct damage and cannot be charged. Carian Filigreed Crest is redundant due to the 0 FP cost. Synergizes optimally with the Dagger Talisman, Assassin's Crimson Dagger, and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger to maximize rewards on subsequent critical strikes.

name: Ash Of War: Storm Blade
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).
effects:
FP Cost: 10 (initial cast), 6 (subsequent chained casts).

Mechanics:
- Unleashes a slicing vacuum blade of storm winds propelled forward over a medium distance. Additional inputs chain successive projectile slashes in rapid succession at reduced FP cost.
- Direct Contact: When used at point-blank melee range, both the physical weapon blade and the storm projectile connect simultaneously, dealing combined weapon and projectile damage.
- Status Buildup: The ranged projectile deals pure physical damage and does not carry over weapon status buildup (such as Bleed or Frost), though the physical blade swing in melee range applies status effects normally.
- Stance Damage: Deals 10 stance damage per projectile hit; landing both the blade swing and the projectile in melee range inflicts substantial composite poise damage.
- Damage Scaling: Projectile damage scales with armament upgrade level and Strength / Dexterity scaling based on weapon affinity, functioning independently from base weapon attack rating.

Armament Compatibility:
- Usable on swords: Straight Swords, Greatswords, Light Greatswords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Katanas, Great Katanas, Thrusting Swords, and Heavy Thrusting Swords.
- Incompatible with Colossal Weapons and Twinblades.

Synergies:
- Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard: Boosts skill attack power by 15% / 10%.
- Enraged Divine Beast: Enhances storm skill damage by 10%.
- Divine Beast Head / Divine Beast Frost Helm: Boosts storm skill damage by 7% / 4%.
- Incompatible with Godfrey Icon (skill cannot be charged) and Arrow's Reach Talisman (does not affect projectile range).

name: Ash Of War: Sword Dance
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Sword Dance: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash."

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons and great spears excepted).
effects: Grants the Keen affinity by default, enhancing Dexterity scaling while reducing Strength scaling and base physical damage. Consumes 6 FP for the initial forward-lunging double upward slash, with an additional input consuming 6 FP for an overhead downward slam (12 FP total). Excels at closing distance and roll-catching. Inflicts physical weapon damage and status build-up across the combo sequence, delivering substantial poise and stance damage. The rapid multi-hit attack sequence triggers successive attack buffs such as the Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, and Millicent's Prosthesis, and skill damage is boosted by Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard (cannot be charged, so Godfrey Icon does not apply). Compatible with swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (excluding colossal weapons and great spears).

name: Through And Through
description:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Through and Through: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.

Usable on greatbows.
effects: Grants the Through and Through skill. Assuming the preparatory oblique stance costs 0 FP, while loosing a greatarrow costs 9 FP and stamina. The resulting shot deals approximately 30% increased physical damage compared to standard firing and completely penetrates through consecutive targets in its trajectory, delivering heavy stance damage and significant stagger or knockdown to lighter foes. If executed without sufficient FP, the greatarrow loses its penetrating properties and suffers a significant damage reduction. Armament Class Compatibility: Greatbows only. Scaling & Synergies: Skill damage is enhanced by the Shard of Alexander and Arrow's Sting Talisman; effective range and projectile velocity benefit from the Arrow's Reach Talisman. The skill cannot be charged, so it does not benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Thunderbolt
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

"Thunderbolt: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects: Grants the Lightning affinity and the Thunderbolt skill. Costs 10 FP per cast. The user thrusts their armament skyward, summoning an instantaneous lightning bolt directly from above onto the target. Can be chained in rapid succession with shortened recovery intervals between consecutive casts. Deals pure Lightning damage that scales strictly with the armament's upgrade level and Dexterity stat, benefiting strongly from Lightning infusion. Deals 5 stance damage per strike and cannot be parried. Synergizes with Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard for boosted skill damage, Lightning Scorpion Charm, and Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear. Cannot be charged and therefore does not benefit from Godfrey Icon. Compatible with all melee armaments.

name: Ash Of War: Unsheathe
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Unsheathe: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack."

Usable on katanas.
effects:
Grants the Keen affinity by default, increasing Dexterity scaling while decreasing Strength scaling and base physical damage. Usable exclusively on standard Katanas (cannot be applied to Great Katanas or unique somber weapons).

Skill Mechanics:
• Stance: Enters an iaido ready stance at 0 FP and 0 stamina cost. Can be held indefinitely or canceled via dodge roll or jump without resource penalty.
• Light Follow-up (Normal Attack): Consumes 10 FP (24 stamina). Delivers a lightning-fast horizontal slash covering a wide forward arc, dealing ~190% weapon attack power and 15 stance damage.
• Heavy Follow-up (Strong Attack): Consumes 15 FP (40 stamina). Steps forward into a high-damage downward vertical overhead strike, dealing ~245% weapon attack power and 30 stance damage (capable of staggering most bosses in 3–4 hits).
• Scaling & Status: Scales directly with total armament Attack Rating (AR) and weapon upgrade level. Fully applies active weapon greases, weapon buffs, and 100% of weapon status buildup (such as innate bleed).
• Synergies: Boosted by Shard of Alexander (+15% damage) and Rellana's Cameo (+45% damage when holding the stance for ~1 second). FP consumption is reduced by Carian Filigreed Crest (-25% FP). Ineligible for Godfrey Icon as the skill is stance-based and cannot be charged.

name: Ash Of War: Vacuum Slice
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

"Vacuum Slice: Lost skill of ancient heroes. Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile."

Usable on swords and axes (colossal axes excepted).
effects:
Grants the Quality affinity by default, balancing Strength and Dexterity scaling. Applicable to swords and axes (with Colossal Axes excepted).

Skill Mechanics:
• Skill: Vacuum Slice
• FP Cost: 14 FP
• Behavior: The user raises the weapon aloft to generate a shearing gale and performs a downward slash, sending forth a vertical blade-like wind projectile. The projectile penetrates through targets along its path.
• Damage & Scaling: Deals pure physical Standard damage. Point-blank strikes deal combined damage from both the physical weapon blow and the wind projectile. Damage scales with weapon upgrade level and the armament's scaling attributes, favoring Strength and Dexterity. Projectile damage calculations reference one-handed Attack Rating, ignoring the two-handed Strength multiplier.
• Stance Damage: Inflicts 20 stance damage when both the physical melee hit and projectile hit connect.
• Status Buildup: The projectile does not transmit weapon coatings, greases, or innate status buildup (such as Bleed or Frost); status buildup is only applied if the physical armament itself strikes the target.
• Synergies: Skill attack power is enhanced by Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard. The skill cannot be charged, and therefore receives no benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Troll's Roar
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Troll's Roar: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down."

Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity (improving Strength scaling). Consumes 22 FP on initial skill activation to emit a massive 360-degree concussive roar shockwave that deals physical damage and knocks back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack (R2/heavy input) for 0 additional FP to unleash a devastating overhead weapon slam into the ground.

Stance Damage: The point-blank roar deals 40 stance damage (decaying to 11/9 on outer shockwave edges), and the follow-up heavy slam inflicts 33 to 45 stance damage depending on weapon category (peaking on Colossal Weapons and Great Hammers).

Armament Compatibility: Usable on large and colossal melee armaments, including Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Greataxes, Great Hammers, Colossal Weapons, and Great Katanas.

Synergies & Mechanics: Physical damage scales with armament upgrade level and Strength scaling. Grants substantial hyper armor during startup and execution. Synergizes with Shard of Alexander (+15% skill damage). Both the shockwave and follow-up slam receive damage bonuses from the Roar Medallion (+15%) and the Highland Axe passive effect (+10%, which stacks multiplicatively and functions even when held in the off-hand).

name: Ash Of War: War Cry
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"War Cry: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks."

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).
effects: Costs 16 FP to activate. Emits a war shout that releases a small shockwave capable of staggering nearby minor enemies and grants a 40-second self-buff. Increases weapon physical attack power by 7.5% and replaces standard strong attacks (R2/RT) with aggressive running and charging lunges followed by powerful sweeping strikes. Fully charged heavy attacks deal significantly enhanced physical damage, high stance damage, and grant increased hyper armor during the charge. Synergizes multiplicatively with the Roar Medallion (+15%) and Highland Axe (+10%), which both augment roar-altered heavy attacks, as well as the Axe Talisman (+10%) and Spiked Cracked Tear for charged attacks. Neither Shard of Alexander nor Godfrey Icon boost the altered heavy attacks, as they only buff direct skill damage and chargeable FP skills.

name: Ash Of War: Vow Of The Indomitable
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

"Vow of the Indomitable: Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree. Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility."

Usable on all shields.
effects:
Grants the Sacred affinity by default, providing Faith scaling and Holy damage while adjusting physical damage negations. Compatible with all shield types (Small Shields, Medium Shields, and Greatshields).

Skill Mechanics:
- FP Cost: 20 FP. If activated with insufficient FP, the animation executes but grants zero invulnerability frames.
- Execution: The user holds their shield aloft, enveloping themselves in a brief golden mantle.
- Frame Data (30 FPS base / 60 FPS equivalent):
 * Startup: 4 frames (8 frames at 60 FPS)
 * Active Invulnerability (i-frames): 30 frames / 1.0 second (60 frames at 60 FPS)
 * Recovery: 2 frames (4 frames at 60 FPS)
- Damage & Stance: Deals 0 damage and 0 stance damage (pure defensive skill with no hitbox).
- Damage & Status Negation: Grants complete immunity to all incoming physical and elemental damage (Magic, Fire, Lightning, Holy), status effect buildup (Blood Loss, Frostbite, Poison, Scarlet Rot, Sleep, Madness, Death Blight), and hit detection from grab attacks during the active window. Attacks connecting during the active window do not count as landed hits, preventing enemy on-hit healing triggers (such as Malenia's health recovery). Does not prevent lethal fall damage.
- Talisman Synergies:
 * Carian Filigreed Crest: Reduces FP cost from 20 to 15.
 * Shard of Alexander / Warrior Jar Shard / Godfrey Icon: Ineffective, as the skill lacks an attack hitbox and cannot be charged.
 * Old Lord's Talisman: Ineffective, as it affects only spells and incantations.

name: Ash Of War: Waves Of Darkness
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Waves of Darkness: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."

Usable on greataxes, warhammers, and colossal weapons.
effects:
Thrusts the armament into the earth to trigger three concentric, expanding shockwaves of dark magic, staggering foes and dealing pure magic damage. Pressing strong attack executes a sweeping upwards slash for heavy physical and magic damage.

• FP Cost: 16 (initial plunge and waves) + 5 (heavy follow-up swing) for 21 total FP.
• Armament Compatibility: Greataxes, Great Hammers (Warhammers), Great Spears, and Colossal Weapons.
• Damage Scaling: Shockwave damage scales primarily with Intelligence and weapon upgrade level, achieving peak damage with Magic or Cold infusions. The ground plunge and sweeping follow-up scale with the weapon's total Attack Rating (AR).
• Stance Damage: Inflicts massive posture damage (~34 total stance damage across the wave sequence and initial impact), easily breaking enemy guard. Provides Level 3 hyper armor throughout the plunge animation to resist interruption.
• Status Buildup: Innate weapon status effects (such as Frostbite or Blood Loss) apply on direct weapon strikes (the initial plunge and follow-up sweep), but do not apply through the magic shockwaves.
• Synergies: Enhanced by Shard of Alexander (+15% damage), Magic Scorpion Charm (+12% magic damage), and Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (+20% magic damage). Ineligible for Godfrey Icon as it cannot be charged, and unaffected by the Spellblade Set due to unique projectile properties.

name: Ash Of War: White Shadow's Lure
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

"White Shadow's Lure: Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow. The apparition lures in human-build foes who are not currently in combat, drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in combat."

Usable on all melee armaments.
effects:
Grants the Occult affinity, shifting weapon scaling primarily toward Arcane and boosting innate status buildup (such as Blood Loss or Poison) present on the weapon.

Skill Mechanics:
• FP Cost: 15 FP.
• Action: The user briefly holds the armament upright in a silent prayer, conjuring a glowing white apparition decoy a short distance ahead that lingers for approximately 5 seconds.
• Aggression Redirection: Attracts and holds the attention of human-sized foes who are not yet actively in combat, pulling their positioning and enabling stealth bypasses or easy backstabs. Possesses a unique effect against demi-human enemies, successfully redirecting their aggression even if they are already alerted and engaged in combat with the player. Ineffective against bosses, colossal enemies, and non-humanoid beasts.
• Damage & Stance Damage: Deals no direct damage and inflicts 0 stance damage; purely a tactical utility and stealth decoy.
• Armament Compatibility: Can be applied to all melee armaments that support Ashes of War (daggers, swords, axes, hammers, polearms, colossal weapons, fists, claws, whips, and shields).
• Key Synergies: Combines effectively with backstab and critical hit gear such as the Dagger Talisman, Assassin's Crimson Dagger, and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger. FP consumption is reduced from 15 to 11 FP by the Carian Filigreed Crest. As a non-damaging skill, it does not benefit from Shard of Alexander or Godfrey Icon.

name: Ash Of War: Wild Strikes
description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Wild Strikes: Swing armament with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack."

Usable on axes and hammers as well as curved swords and greatswords (colossal weapons excepted).
effects:
Grants the Heavy affinity (prioritizing Strength scaling) and skill Wild Strikes.

• FP Consumption: 2 FP to activate; continuously drains ~1 FP per swing while held; normal attack follow-up costs 10 FP; strong attack follow-up costs 15 FP.
• Attack Sequence: Continuously swings the armament in alternating left and right slashes as long as the skill button is held and stamina/FP remain. The wielder can slowly walk and turn during the loop. Inputting a normal attack transitions into a broad horizontal sweep; inputting a strong attack executes a heavy downward slam.
• Armament Compatibility: Usable on axes, greataxes, hammers, great hammers, flails, curved swords, curved greatswords, greatswords, and great katanas. Incompatible with colossal weapons, colossal swords, thrusting swords, katanas, spears, halberds, reapers, whips, fists, claws, and ranged armaments.
• Damage Scaling & Buildup: Each swing directly applies weapon damage and full status buildup (Bleed, Frost, Poison, Rot), making it exceptionally potent on innate status weapons or when coated with greases and weapon buff incantations/sorceries.
• Stance Damage & Hyper Armor: Continuous swings deliver consistent poise pressure and continuously reset enemy stance recovery timers. The light follow-up inflicts high stance damage (~20-28 depending on weapon class), while the strong follow-up inflicts massive stance damage (~30-42, rivaling fully charged heavy attacks). Grants substantial hyper armor during both the swinging loop and follow-ups, preventing interruption from light-to-medium enemy attacks.
• Synergies: Boosted directly by Shard of Alexander and Warrior Jar Shard (+15%/+10% skill damage). Exceptionally potent with multi-hit talismans and tears—Winged Sword Insignia, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and Thorny Cracked Tear—which quickly reach maximum attack tiers due to rapid attack cadence. Bull-Goat's Talisman substantially reinforces hyper armor trading capabilities by reducing received poise damage.

name: Lost Ashes Of War
description:
Empty ashes of war, devoid of any memories of battle.

Unable to apply any kind of affinity in their current state, but can be used by Smithing Master Hewg of the Roundtable Hold to recreate other ashes.

Thus does the copy pass into becoming the genuine article.
effects: Consumable key item categorized under Ashes of War. It cannot be directly equipped to any armament and provides no skill, FP cost, affinity, or direct combat scaling. Instead, it serves as a unique smithing component consumed by Smithing Master Hewg at the Roundtable Hold to duplicate any Ash of War currently held in the inventory. Duplication allows the reproduced Ash of War and its associated affinities to be equipped simultaneously on multiple compatible weapons (such as dual-wielded power-stance armaments or backup weapons). Found as a finite resource throughout the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow or purchased from select merchants.
